Forgotten Pacts.title: Demonic Attributes
Forgotten Pacts.blurb: Modular traits rolled for summoned/encountered demons — 20 Minor, 20 Major. Each may only appear once per demon.

entries.name: Minor (20)
entries.text: Armoured Hide (+1 Armour) · Backstabber (breaks binding on 17+) · Chameleonic (LoS only within 12") · Demonic Strength (counts as 2-handed) · Extra Arms (+1 Fight) · Extra Legs (+1 Move) · Explosive Demise (+3 elemental blast on death) · Horns (+2 Fight charging) · Horrific (Will TN10 to approach) · Levitation (ignores rough ground) · Magic Attack · Magic Vulnerability (-2 Armour vs magic) · Numbing Touch (-1 Fight on loss) · Poisonous · Teleport (random moves become teleports) · Tentacles (free +0 shot at 2") · True Sight (immune to Beauty/Invisibility/Monstrous Form) · Two Heads (fewer supporting-figure bonuses vs it) · Vampiric (heals 2 on hit) · Vestigial Wings (no fall damage)

entries.name: Major (20)
entries.text: Acidic Blood (Will roll or 3 dmg + weapon destroyed) · Beautiful (Will TN15 to attack) · Blinding Aura (Will TN12 within 6" or blinded) · Celerity (activates twice/turn) · Discorporate (splits into 2 minor demons, then imps, on death) · Elemental Absorption (ignores first 5 elemental dmg) · Insubstantial Movement (moves through terrain/dead space) · Invisible · Invulnerability (immune to normal weapons) · Life Bane (Will TN20 within 3" or 2 dmg) · Maelstrom (-2 to shoot it) · Magic Sink (-2 Casting within 12") · Mind Lock (+2 Will, immune to Mind Control) · Mind Wipe (Will TN18 or -2 Will + lost spell) · Petrifying Stare (Petrify-12 aura) · Regenerate (+3 Health/turn) · Serendipitous (all its rolls +1) · Swirling Darkness (+4 Fight vs shooting) · Thousand Young (spawns imps on 1-4 initiative) · Uncontrollable (Will TN20 or breaks control)

Forgotten Pacts.title: Mystic Brands
Forgotten Pacts.blurb: Mystic Brands take an item slot and count as ongoing spells (cancellable by Dispel/Spelleater/null energy). Burning Marks: rolling a natural 1 on a Will roll sends the bearer temporarily insane; may be sacrificed for +1 damage in a strike (at the cost of 2 damage to self). Devotional Marks: +1 to all Will rolls; may be sacrificed for a one-off +3 Will roll.

entries.name: Mark of Rage
entries.text: +2 Move if the move ends in combat.

entries.name: Mark of the Berserker
entries.text: +2 Fight vs multiple foes.

entries.name: Mark of the Blood
entries.text: +2 damage (+3 with a two-hander).

entries.name: Mark of the Chain
entries.text: +3 Will resisting/breaking spells.

entries.name: Mark of the Fang
entries.text: +1 Fight.

entries.name: Mark of Endurance
entries.text: Never Wounded; immune to poison.

entries.name: Mark of Life
entries.text: +2 Fight, +1 Armour vs undead.

entries.name: Mark of Protection
entries.text: Sacrifice to prevent up to 3 damage.

entries.name: Mark of Sight
entries.text: Immune to Invisibility/Beauty/Monstrous Form.

entries.name: Mark of the Shield
entries.text: +1 Armour.

entries.name: Standard vs Dungeon Set-Up
entries.text: Two table-building modes; Dungeon Set-Up adds "dead space" only Immaterial/Burrowing figures can cross.

entries.name: Spells altered underground
entries.text: Crumble (no effect on dead space) · Leap (can't cross dead space) · Mud (only 1.5" radius on stone floors) · Plane Walk (can cross dead space, can't end there) · Wall (collapses on 15+, attackable: Fight roll 12+ destroys it).

entries.name: Doors & Ceilings
entries.text: Doors cost 1 action/2" to open, block LoS, can't be locked. Ceilings cap vertical movement (10" typical).

entries.name: Lighting
entries.text: Max line of sight 20" (or 16" in deep dark) unless under a Glow spell (24").

entries.name: Treasure placement (underground)
entries.text: One player places all tokens; others may move one, pass, or veto the whole layout.

entries.name: Random Encounters (underground)
entries.text: On a treasure's first pickup, roll a die — 14+ spawns a random creature, placed by whoever beats their level in an opposed roll.

entries.name: Burrowing (new ability)
entries.text: Can move through terrain and dead space on random moves as if not there.

Into the Breeding Pits.title: Traps & secret passages
Into the Breeding Pits.blurb: Rolling a natural 1 for initiative springs a trap on any figure the roller chooses; roll the Trap Table below. Trap Experts/Apprentices/Captains/Thieves/Tunnel Fighters get a bonus vs the Trap Number. Secret Passages: rolling a natural 20 for initiative lets that figure (and its activation group) pass straight through vertical terrain, once, on activation.

rows.name: Caltrops
rows.text: Move TN14 or -2 Move until healed.

rows.name: Cement Spray
rows.text: Move TN14 or can't pick up/drop treasure all game.

rows.name: Death From Above
rows.text: Drops a Level 1 Encounter creature onto the target.

rows.name: Disease
rows.text: Fight TN14 or miss the next game.

rows.name: Explosive Rune
rows.text: +5 magic shooting attack on target & everyone within 2".

rows.name: Mind Maze
rows.text: Will TN12 or lose the activation; spreads to anyone entering combat with the target.

rows.name: Nullwave
rows.text: Cancels all spells in play (incl. binds); Will TN14 or 1 damage.

rows.name: Personal Demon
rows.text: Spawns a Will+10 minor demon fixated only on the target.

rows.name: Phosphorescent Spray
rows.text: Move TN16 or glow — shooters get +3, visible to 24" all game.

rows.name: Pick Pocket
rows.text: Fight TN12 or lose held treasure/an item.

rows.name: Pit Trap
rows.text: Move TN14 or fall into a 4" pit.

rows.name: Poison Dart
rows.text: +5 shooting attack; on a hit, one action per activation until healed.

rows.name: Siren
rows.text: Pulls all uncontrolled creatures 6" toward the target.

rows.name: Smoke Bomb
rows.text: 2" smoke cloud; Will TN12 or lose the coming turn.

rows.name: Spring-loaded Axe
rows.text: +3 attack, +2 damage on a win.

rows.name: Teleport Pad
rows.text: Random teleport d20+5" away.

rows.name: Time Slip
rows.text: Will TN12 or vanish from the board until a later TN8 Will roll succeeds.

rows.name: Wall of Force
rows.text: Will TN14 or +0 attack & thrown 5".

rows.name: Whispers
rows.text: Will TN14 or an opponent moves you up to 6".

rows.name: Willsap
rows.text: Will TN14 or Will drops to +0 (or -1) for the game.

The Maze of Malcor.title: Optional core rule updates
The Maze of Malcor.blurb: The 12-scenario campaign also introduces full Sky Gondola vehicle rules (movement, boarding up to 5 figures, combat, Fight+0/Armour14/Health30 as a target, 500–1000gc buy/sell) and an alternate "Forces of Malcor" mode where one player runs Malcor and his monsters as a intelligent opponent instead of uncontrolled creatures.

entries.name: Treasure Placement II
entries.text: One central token, then one per player within 8" of it, then one more anywhere 9"+ from any edge.

entries.name: Securing Treasure
entries.text: Unclaimed tokens at game-end: 15+ on a die secures them for a player with figures still on table.

entries.name: Auto Success/Failure
entries.text: Natural 20 on any Target Number roll auto-succeeds (even Will rolls vs spells); natural 1 auto-fails.

entries.name: Experience Table II
entries.text: +5 failed cast w/ damage · +10 successful cast (Casting No. >6) · +40 per game played · +50 per treasure secured · +5 per uncontrolled kill (cap 50). Game cap 300 XP.

entries.name: Casting Roll floor
entries.text: A successful Casting Roll is treated as the actual roll or 14, whichever is higher.

entries.name: Scrolls rework
entries.text: Cast an unknown spell, or insure a known one against failure — either way treat the Casting Roll as exactly 12.

entries.name: Uncontrolled Creature Actions II
entries.text: Adds a ranged-attack priority step before "move toward closest figure."

entries.name: Balancing Scenarios
entries.text: 6+ level gap between wizards spawns a random creature controlled by the lower-level player.

entries.name: Black Market Contacts
entries.text: Purchasing options are limited to 4 rolls on the Treasure Table (ignoring gold) after each game.

entries.name: Creating Experienced Wizards
entries.text: Formal step-by-step process to build a wizard above level 0 for a mid-campaign join or one-off.

The Maze of Malcor.title: The Pentangle — five lost schools
The Maze of Malcor.blurb: Not intended as playable wizard schools — their spells exist only on scrolls found in the Collegium — but rules are included for using them as full schools if a group agrees.

rows.name: Astromancer
rows.text: Combines Sigilist + Elementalist · Aligned with Elementalist, Sigilist

rows.name: Distortionist
rows.text: Combines Illusionist + Summoner · Aligned with Illusionist, Summoner

rows.name: Fatecaster
rows.text: Combines Soothsayer + Witch · Aligned with Soothsayer, Witch

rows.name: Sonancer
rows.text: Combines Chronomancer + Enchanter · Aligned with Chronomancer, Enchanter

rows.name: Spiritualist
rows.text: Combines Necromancer + Thaumaturge · Aligned with Necromancer, Thaumaturge

entries.name: Alignment / Meteor Strike / Misalignment / Shape Starfire Elemental / Starfall / Starfire Bolt
entries.text: Health-on-cast synergy, a +7 shooting blast, self-damaging spellstorm, summonable elemental, area mines, and a +4 elemental bolt.

entries.name: Break Armour / Collapse / Fracture / Implode-Explode / Misstep / Whiplash
entries.text: Armour destruction, a +4 terrain-based blast, a combat-only free attack, mass pull/push, pre-game enemy reposition, and a movement teleport.

entries.name: Blood Wager / Fickle Finger / Mischance / Scatter / Serendipity / True Gold
entries.text: Coin-flip full heal or half-Health loss, action-count randomizer, forced disadvantage/advantage rolls, treasure-token shove, and a treasure reroll.

entries.name: Charm / Imbue Instrument / Humming Blade / Steal Voice / Sound Cloud / Sound Wave
entries.text: Animal pacify, an instrument that can become a permanent +2 Will item, armour-shredding weapon buff, spellcaster silence, melee debuff aura, and a knockback shot.

entries.name: Call Wraith / Command Ethereal / Ethereal Form / Inhabit / Nightmare / Speak with the Dead
entries.text: Summons a wraith, puppeteers ethereal undead, grants temporary ethereal form, possesses a construct/undead, curses a rival's XP long-term, and boosts a future Out of Game cast.

Thaw of the Lich Lord.title: Lichdom — failing the cast
Thaw of the Lich Lord.blurb: Lichdom — Necromancer / 20 / Out of Game. Only a wizard may cast it, tearing his soul from his body to animate his own corpse. Success makes him a Lich outright; failure is punishing and scales with how badly the roll was missed: A successful Lich is subject to a distinct rules package for the rest of the campaign — effectively a third alongside Demonic Pacts and Beastcrafter as a mutually-flavored "wizard state":

rows.text: -1 level, -1 Health stat.
-3 levels, -2 Health, -1 Will, 1 random permanent injury.
-5 levels, -3 Health, -2 Will, 2 random permanent injuries.
-8 levels, -6 Health, -2 Will, 3 random permanent injuries.
The wizard's soul is lost — unrecoverable by any means.

The Perilous Dark.title: Solo & co-op toolkit
The Perilous Dark.blurb: Also codifies house style for "boss monsters" (make them multi-step puzzles, not just high stat-lines — and make them immune to Mind Control) and gives explicit guidance that solo/co-op tables should run less crowded than a normal Frostgrave table, since the simple creature AI can't exploit terrain the way a player can.

entries.name: Warband building
entries.text: Solo: build a warband as normal. Co-op: each player's wizard gets only 200gc and a max of 4 soldiers, so two players together land close to a solo warband's power.

entries.name: Objectives over treasure
entries.text: Place only 2 treasure tokens solo (3 co-op) in hard-to-reach spots, and shift most of the XP budget onto scenario-specific goals (e.g. "+80 XP if the statue is destroyed") to keep games from becoming a pure gold-count.

entries.name: New turn sequence
entries.text: Wizard Phase → Creature Phase I (creatures with Fight +5 or Health 20+) → Apprentice Phase → Creature Phase II (everyone else) → Soldier Phase — lets dangerous monsters act before the party's own soldiers.

entries.name: Updated creature AI
entries.text: Creatures activate in current-Health order, always move to engage the highest-level spellcaster if one move can do it, never intentionally pick a multi-combat, and all creatures get a flat +2 Will.

entries.name: Limited Duration spells
entries.text: Circle of Protection, Invisibility, Monstrous Form, and Wall: roll a die at the end of any turn they're active — on a 1–10 the spell ends early (replaces Wall's normal end-of-turn roll).

entries.name: Target Points
entries.text: Instead of random movement, uncontrolled creatures head for a designer-nominated point (usually the objective) — makes the AI feel purposeful instead of aimless.

entries.name: Monster spawning
entries.text: Bespoke per-scenario spawn tables (not the core random-encounter table) tied to numbered spawn points, so the designer controls both what shows up and where.

entries.name: Clue Markers
entries.text: Treasure-token-like markers that reward investigation (an action + a roll on a scenario-specific clue table) — the game's investigation/mystery layer.

entries.name: Room Cards
entries.text: Draw a card to set up the next room only when a door is opened, so players never see the whole table at once; can also define room shape/doorway count for a lightweight dungeon crawl.

entries.name: Closely Connected Scenarios
entries.text: Rules for chaining scenarios back-to-back without a return to base: partial healing (+6 or half Health), no buying/selling/hiring, one Out of Game spell each.

The Perilous Dark.title: Dungeon crawl systems
The Perilous Dark.blurb: Two full worked examples ship with the book: The Vaults (a fixed 10-card dungeon deck with two objective rooms — a treasure hoard and a stairway down) and Dungeons Deep (the fully randomly-generated version, with its own room/encounter/treasure tables and the Gateway Home rule in action).

entries.name: Dungeon Cards
entries.text: Like Room Cards but smaller and more numerous (10–12 sections instead of 3–5 rooms); the deck is split into a "multi-exit" pile and an "objective room" pile, then interleaved so objectives can't appear too early.

entries.name: Randomly Generated Dungeon
entries.text: Each new room triggers three rolls — a room table, an encounter table, and a treasure/clue table — for a fully improvised dungeon; includes a Will TN20 "search for a secret door" rule to rescue dead-ended layouts.

entries.name: Gateway Room / Home
entries.text: The randomly generated dungeon's designated exit: only spawns once 6+ rooms are revealed, guarded by a double encounter roll, and is the sole way off the table.

The Frostgrave Folio.title: Hunt for the Golem / Dark Alchemy Treasure Tables

rows.name: Roll tables
rows.text: Hunt for the Golem Treasure Table (d20, per token): 1–4 Construct Hammer 200gc; 5–8 Construct Oil 300gc; 9–12 Mind Wrench 250gc; 13–16 Truestroke Chisel 250gc; 17–20 Book of the Construct 250gc. Dark Alchemy Treasure Table (d20): 1–5 straight gold (15/20/25/30/40gc); 6–8 gold+Potion; 9–11 gold+Scroll; 12–14 gold+2 Potions; 15 3 Potions; 16 Magic Weapon/Armour; 17 Magic Item; 18–20 Grimoire.

rows.name: Errata
rows.text: Errata: Illusionary Soldiers can never be hired as a Captain. Nullmen null-fields don't add extra effects for demons/constructs/undead beyond the standard anti-magic restriction — e.g. a zombie under Control Undead in a null field keeps its body (though control breaks), and a controlled demon isn't banished (though Bind Demon is dispelled).

Grave Mutations.title: The Grave Mutations Table (d1000)
Grave Mutations.blurb: Roll three differently-coloured d10s and read them as hundreds/tens/units (a result of “000” is read as 1000) to get a number 1–1000, then apply the matching permanent mutation below. Meant to be drawn on generically for magical mishaps, mutation events, or campaign mechanics (starting rolls, sorcerer-purchased mutations, quick monster generation). Unless an entry says otherwise, a mutation never grants spellcasting.

rows.name: 1. Crystalline Body
rows.text: The figure's body changes to a hard crystal. It gains +2 Armour, but its Health is reduced by half, rounding up.

rows.name: 2. Bestial Features
rows.text: The figure takes on some of the appearance of a specific animal of the player's choice. The figure gains the Animal trait but retains its item slots and ability to pick up treasure tokens if it had them previously.

rows.name: 3. Prehensile Feet
rows.text: This figure has feet that can be used as hands. It gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 4. Cyclops
rows.text: The figure's eyes merge into one large eye in the middle of its face. The figure suffers the same penalties as for the Lost Eye permanent injury.

rows.name: 5. Leg Tentacles
rows.text: The figure's legs are replaced with a mass of tentacles. It never suffers movement penalties for movement over rough ground; however, the maximum distance it can jump horizontally is always reduced by 1".

rows.name: 6. Skull Projection
rows.text: This figure can project its own skull out of its head and rapidly grow a new one to replace it. Treat this figure as though it has the Animate Skull spell with a Casting Number of 6. This figure may never improve this spell.

rows.name: 7. Rapid Healer
rows.text: While it doesn't quite reach the level of regeneration, this figure heals wounds extremely rapidly. Treat any "Badly Wounded" permanent injuries as Full Recovery instead. This figure always returns to full Health after any game, regardless of any other rules or circumstances.

rows.name: 8. Soulmarked
rows.text: This figure has been marked by a demonic entity and gains the Demon trait but retains any item slots it previously possessed.

rows.name: 9. Flesh Pocket
rows.text: This figure has a pocket or pouch built into its body. This figure may carry one extra item that takes up no more than one slot.

rows.name: 10. Elbow Spikes
rows.text: This figure has sharp spikes protruding from its elbows. They are dangerous, if awkward to use. This figure never suffers any damage penalty for being unarmed.

rows.name: 11. Acidic Blood
rows.text: If this figure is damaged in melee combat, all other figures in the combat immediately suffer 1 point of damage.

rows.name: 12. Impact Absorbing Leg Joints
rows.text: This figure's leg joints have mutated to absorb significant impacts from falling. Halve the distance fallen by this figure for the purposes of determining damage.

rows.name: 13. Brittle Bones
rows.text: This figure has a weak bone structure. It receives -1 to all Survival Rolls.

rows.name: 14. Spell Sickness
rows.text: This figure has an allergy towards magic. Whenever it casts a spell, or has any spell cast upon it, it must make a Will Roll (TN10) or suffer 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 15. Crab Claw
rows.text: One of the figure's hands is replaced with a giant crab claw. The figure always counts as carrying a hand weapon that does +1 damage. It may not use shields or any weapons that take more than one hand or item slot.

rows.name: 16. Vulnerable Spot
rows.text: If this figure ever suffers a critical hit, it is immediately reduced to 0 Health and suffers -1 to all Survival Rolls after the game.

rows.name: 17. Undead Bane
rows.text: This figure absorbs the energy that holds undead creatures together. Any undead figure that moves within 1" of this figure, or activates while within 1", immediately suffers 1 point of damage.

rows.name: 18. Quick Reflexes
rows.text: The figure gains a permanent +1 Fight.

rows.name: 19. Third Arm
rows.text: The figure has three arms and may now carry a shield at the same time as a staff or other two-handed weapon. Additionally, it gains one item slot.

rows.name: 20. Gills
rows.text: The figure grows gills which allow it to breathe underwater. It gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 21. Soulseer
rows.text: The figure can see the glowing souls of living creatures. It gains the True Sight trait.

rows.name: 22. Fate Kissed
rows.text: This figure has been marked by fate for some special purpose. Once per game, it may reroll one Combat Roll, Will Roll, or Stat Roll. If this ability isn't used during a game, it may be used after the game for a Survival Roll.

rows.name: 23. Redundant Organs
rows.text: This figure has a complete second set of organs. This figure is Immune to Critical Hits.

rows.name: 24. Eye Stalks
rows.text: The figure's eyes project far outside or above its head, allowing it easier vision in all directions. This figure receives +1 Fight when making Combat Rolls against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 25. Temporary Growth
rows.text: This figure can grow larger for short periods of time. Once per game, the figure may spend an action, even when in combat, to grow. The figure gains +2 Fight, +2 damage, +2 Armour and the Large trait for the remainder of this turn and all of the next turn. After that, it returns to normal size.

rows.name: 26. Bleeder
rows.text: This figure bleeds freely from the smallest of wounds. It counts as Wounded any time it is below full Health.

rows.name: 27. Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has numerous tentacles which it can use to grapple and entrap enemies. Opponents of this figure may not push it back, or step back, in melee unless they actually do damage; simply winning the combat is not enough.

rows.name: 28. Toxic Bile
rows.text: This figure can vomit up toxic bile. It can make shooting attacks with a 3" range, -1 damage, and poison.

rows.name: 29. Withered
rows.text: This figure has had most of the moisture permanently sucked out of its body. The figure suffers a permanent -2 Health.

rows.name: 30. Magically-Attuned Cyclops
rows.text: The figure has a single giant eye, which can be anywhere on its body. The figure suffers -1 to all Combat Rolls against shooting attacks, but all of its attacks of any type count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 31. Hard to Control Fire Breath
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to breathe fire. Make a +5 magic shooting attack against the three closest figures, provided they are within 10".

rows.name: 32. Unstable Energy Drain
rows.text: This figure deals double damage in combat; however, it also suffers damage equal to half of the damage it deals. This ability does not affect undead or constructs.

rows.name: 33. Elemental Armour
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (3).

rows.name: 34. Armoured Organs
rows.text: This figure has internal armour that protects its vital organs. It gains the Immune to Critical Hits trait.

rows.name: 35. Poison Feeder
rows.text: This figure gains the Immune to Poison trait. Additionally, if this figure is ever damaged by another figure with a poison attack, it gains the Poison ability for its next melee attack.

rows.name: 36. Force of Rage
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to attempt to cast Destructive Sphere. Treat the spell as having a Casting Number of 5. This roll may be empowered. This Casting Number may never be improved.

rows.name: 37. Undead
rows.text: The figure gains the Undead trait. If it is already undead, reroll.

rows.name: 38. Ill-Fated
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls on the Survival Table, it must roll two dice and take the lowest result.

rows.name: 39. Golden Eggs
rows.text: This figure produces a valuable substance as part of its natural life processes. Gain 5gc after every game in which this figure participates and survives.

rows.name: 40. Squishy
rows.text: This figure is just kind of soft. It suffers a permanent -1 Armour.

rows.name: 41. Stealthy
rows.text: At the start of the game, after all figures, terrain and treasure have been placed, but before initiative on the first turn is rolled, this figure may move up to 3" in any direction, so long as it ends the move out of line of sight of any enemy figures.

rows.name: 42. Vampiric
rows.text: This figure must consume the lifeforce of other creatures to heal. Whenever this figure inflicts damage in melee combat, it immediately regains up to 3 lost points of Health. This figure may not be healed in any other way during a scenario, though it follows the normal rules for healing between scenarios.

rows.name: 43. Blessed
rows.text: This figure is blessed by some higher power. It receives +1 to all Stat Rolls (rolls with a specific Target Number).

rows.name: 44. Sticky Feet
rows.text: Thanks to its sticky feet (or other appendage) it gains +10 to all Move Rolls to avoid falling.

rows.name: 45. Power Lifter
rows.text: This figure never suffers any encumbrance penalty for carrying treasure tokens.

rows.name: 46. Chameleonic Skin
rows.text: This figure can blend in with its surroundings. Other figures must be within 12" to draw line of sight to this figure unless they have True Sight.

rows.name: 47. Puncture Resistant Skin
rows.text: This figure takes -1 damage from all non-area effect shooting attacks.

rows.name: 48. Pain Sight
rows.text: This figure gains the True Sight trait whenever its Health stat is below its maximum.

rows.name: 49. Hammerblow
rows.text: Whenever this figure pushes an opponent back after winning a round of combat, it may elect to push the opponent back 1 - 3". This cannot be used against opponents with the Large trait, unless this figure also has the Large trait.

rows.name: 50. Breakable
rows.text: Due to a weak physique, whenever this figure rolls "Badly Wounded" on the Survival Table it suffers a permanent -1 Health.

rows.name: 51. Icy Grasp
rows.text: This figure does +2 damage in melee combat. This bonus does not apply when in combat with undead or constructs.

rows.name: 52. Anger Strength
rows.text: This figure does +1 damage in melee combat if it is below its starting Health.

rows.name: 53. Phosphorescent Spray
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to spray a phosphorescent film at an opponent within 6" and line of sight. The spray affects all figures that are either in contact or in combat with the target figure. The target and all other affected figures must make a Move Roll (TN20). If a figure fails, it is covered with the film and all shooting rolls against it are at +3 for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 54. Telekinetic Pull
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN20). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 3" directly towards the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 55. Hideous Stench
rows.text: This figure reeks. Any figure that wishes to move within 1" of this figure, or into combat with this figure, must first pass a Will Roll (TN8). Figures that do not have to smell, such as constructs and undead, do not have to make this roll.

rows.name: 56. Temporally Unstable
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls a natural "1" on any roll, it temporarily blips out of time. Remove the figure from the table but mark its spot. At the end of each turn, roll a die. On a 12+ the figure returns to the table at the exact spot it left (or as close as is possible if the spot is occupied). The figure does still suffer the effects of rolling the "1", such as taking damage in combat.

rows.name: 57. Two Heads
rows.text: The figure has two heads, which makes it more difficult to gang up against. Figures only grant a +1 supporting figure bonus when fighting this figure.

rows.name: 58. Bloodboil
rows.text: This figure may supercharge its blood flow. Before each game, it may choose to suffer 3 damage to gain either +1 Fight or +1 Shoot.

rows.name: 59. Numbing Blow
rows.text: Whenever this figure damages an opponent in melee combat, the opponent also suffers -1 Fight until the end of the game. This penalty is cumulative (to a minimum +0 Fight). Does not apply to figures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 60. Lashing Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has tentacles that whip around its body. Any figure (including friendly ones) that moves or activates within 2" of this figure suffers a +0 shooting attack.

rows.name: 61. Blood Allergy
rows.text: This figure is allergic to the blood of other creatures. If it damages another figure in melee combat, it is poisoned.

rows.name: 62. Light Sensitivity
rows.text: This figure's vision is very sensitive to light. It suffers -1 to all shooting attacks and Combat Rolls against incoming shooting attacks, unless the figure is under cover, underground, or there is some special scenario rule in play that is decreasing the line of sight due to lack of light.

rows.name: 63. Scorpion Tail
rows.text: This figure has a scorpion tail growing out of its body. It always counts as armed with a poisonous hand weapon.

rows.name: 64. Minor Regeneration
rows.text: This figure gains back 1 lost point of Health every time it activates.

rows.name: 65. Leaping Attack
rows.text: This figure gains +2 Move, but only if that movement ends with the figure in combat.

rows.name: 66. Trunk
rows.text: This figure has a very long nose, which it can use to sound its battle cry. This figure may spend an action to trumpet. This figure and all allied figures gain +2 to all Will Rolls until its next activation.

rows.name: 67. Tusks
rows.text: This figure has long tusks. It always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 68. Easily Weakened
rows.text: Whenever this figure suffers damage from any source, it suffers -1 Fight as well. This penalty is cumulative to a minimum of +0 Fight.

rows.name: 69. Extra Eye
rows.text: This figure has an extra eye which helps with both field and depth of vision. The figure gains +1 Fight whenever it is rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 70. Insect Head
rows.text: The figure has the head of an insect, including a sharp set of mandibles. This figure always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 71. Horns
rows.text: This figure gains the Horns trait.

rows.name: 72. Pain Instability
rows.text: This figure inadvertently teleports whenever it suffers damage. Whenever this figure suffers 1 or more points of damage, it automatically teleports 1 - 10" in a random direction, stopping at the edge of the table if the teleport would carry it off.

rows.name: 73. Demonic Allergy
rows.text: This figure is allergic to demonic energies. Whenever it moves within 1" of a demon, or activates within 1" of a demon, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, it suffers 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 74. Stick Thin
rows.text: This figure is extremely thin. It suffers -1 Armour but may squeeze through any opening that is at least 0.5" wide.

rows.name: 75. Burning Fists
rows.text: This figure can cause its fists to ignite in flames on command. It always counts as armed with a magical hand weapon that does +1 elemental damage.

rows.name: 76. Brachiator
rows.text: This figure is capable of movement by swinging from hand-hold to hand-hold. It gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 77. Partial Insanity
rows.text: If this figure ever rolls a natural "1" on any roll during the game, it goes temporarily insane and counts as an uncontrolled creature. This lasts for the rest of the turn on which the "1" was rolled and all the next turn. After that, the insanity passes, and the figure returns to its normal allegiance.

rows.name: 78. Empowered Blow
rows.text: If this figure forgoes all its actions for one activation, during an activation where it receives at least one action, then the next time it hits an opponent in melee combat, the strike does an additional +5 elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 79. Long Neck
rows.text: This figure has an elongated neck, which unfortunately makes it vulnerable. It suffers +6 damage any time it suffers a critical hit (instead of the normal +5).

rows.name: 80. Weak Arms
rows.text: Whenever this figure wins a round of combat, it may only step back; it may never push its opponent back.

rows.name: 81. Volatile Excrement
rows.text: This figure excretes a volatile mixture. If it forgoes all its actions in an activation, in an activation where it has at least one action, it may place a marker on the table. If any other creature moves within 2" of this marker, it explodes, and all figures within 2" suffer a +4 shooting attack. This figure may never have more than two such markers on the table at one time. This figure never triggers its own tokens and is immune to damage from them.

rows.name: 82. Quick Reactions
rows.text: This figure may activate in any phase during the turn, overriding any other normal rules for activation. It always activates last in that phase if it is not the phase the rules would normally require. This figure may still only activate once per turn unless another rule allows multiple activations.

rows.name: 83. Long Legs
rows.text: This figure has long legs that grant it +1 Move.

rows.name: 84. Blinding Gaze
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to automatically cast the Blinding Light spell at a target within line of sight. Treat the Casting Number as 16.

rows.name: 85. Cloud Release
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to release a cloud of dark gas. Place a 2" diameter cloud adjacent to the figure. The figure suffers 1 point of damage every time it does this. Line of sight may not be drawn through the cloud. At the end of every turn, roll a die. On a 1 - 5, the cloud dissipates and should be removed from the table.

rows.name: 86. Bleeder
rows.text: This figure loses 1 point of Health every time it activates if it is already below its maximum starting Health. This rule does not apply if the figure only has 1 point of Health remaining.

rows.name: 87. Large Brain
rows.text: This figure has a very large brain, meaning that its head is noticeably larger than normal. It receives +2 Will but -2 Health.

rows.name: 88. Surrounded by Flies
rows.text: This figure is constantly surrounded by flies or other flying insects. It and all other figures within 2" suffer -1 to all rolls.

rows.name: 89. Frog Legs
rows.text: This figure has grown frog-like legs that give it a huge jump. It may now jump up to its full move distance without any run-up, including horizontally.

rows.name: 90. Missing Digits
rows.text: This figure is missing several fingers, which makes it difficult to use ranged weapons. It has -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 91. Mana Battery (1)
rows.text: This figure produces mystical energy that can be tapped by friends who know how. If a figure in the same warband attempts to cast a spell within 3" of this figure, it may draw upon this figure to add +1 to empower the spell by 1. This can only be done once each game.

rows.name: 92. Magic Vulnerability
rows.text: Whenever this figure is hit by a magic attack, it suffers -3 Armour against that attack.

rows.name: 93. Hammerhand
rows.text: This figure's off hand has been replaced by a heavy hammer, or mace-like, protuberance. This figure always counts as armed with a magical hand weapon but can never carry a two-handed weapon, shield, bow, or crossbow.

rows.name: 94. Scrawny Arms
rows.text: This figure suffers double the normal penalty to its Fight and Shoot stats when carrying a treasure token.

rows.name: 95. Withered Arm
rows.text: One of this figure's arms has withered away until it is nearly useless. Treat the figure as though it has the Crushed Arm permanent injury.

rows.name: 96. Serpent Tale
rows.text: This figure has a serpent tail instead of legs. It suffers -1 Move but never suffers movement penalties for going over rough ground.

rows.name: 97. Parachute
rows.text: This figure has wings, webs, or another appendage that significantly slows its descent through the air. This figure never suffers any damage from falling.

rows.name: 98. Three-Arms with Claws
rows.text: This figure has three arms or arm-like appendages with sharp claws. It may use a two-handed weapon or staff at the same time as a shield. Additionally, it never suffers any penalty to damage for being unarmed.

rows.name: 99. Large
rows.text: The figure gains the Large trait and does +1 damage in melee combat.

rows.name: 100. Beak
rows.text: This figure has a beak instead of a mouth and nose. It is always counted as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 101. Frightening Appearance
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to move into combat with this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN6). If it fails, the figure may not move into combat, but may still use the action for another purpose.

rows.name: 102. Steady Heart
rows.text: This figure can momentarily stop all its body's natural processes to completely still its aim. It gains a permanent +1 Shoot.

rows.name: 103. Life Drain
rows.text: Any other figure that activates within 2" of this figure immediately suffers 1 point of damage. Undead and constructs are immune to this. This rule does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 104. Opportunist
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls a natural "20" in melee combat during its own activation, it immediately gains an additional action in this activation.

rows.name: 105. Mouths in Hands
rows.text: This figure has no mouth on its face; instead, it has a mouth in each hand. This figure always counts as being armed with at least a dagger but cannot cast spells or do anything else verbal unless it has a free hand.

rows.name: 106. Adrenaline Surge
rows.text: Once per game, as a free action, this figure can trigger an adrenaline surge. Its Move is increased by 3 for the rest of the turn.

rows.name: 107. Unlife Feeder
rows.text: This figure feeds off the power of animate, but non-living, things. Whenever any undead or construct activates within 2", that figure immediately suffers 1 point of damage. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 108. Extendable Neck
rows.text: This figure can extend its neck so that its head is up to 1" higher than it actually is. Thus, a figure can draw line of sight over objects that are less than 1" higher than it. It may use this to cast spells, but not to make attacks as its hands cannot reach that high (unless the attack is generated by the figure's head).

rows.name: 109. Giant Fighter
rows.text: This figure does +1 damage against figures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 110. Health Transference
rows.text: If this figure is within 2" of a friendly figure, and that figure is not in combat, it may spend an action and take up to 3 points of damage. The other figure heals an amount of damage equal to that amount (though this may not take either figure below 0 Health or above their starting Health).

rows.name: 111. Blood Frenzy
rows.text: If this figure activates within 12" and line of sight of another figure that is currently suffering from the Wounded condition, this figure must spend all its actions moving directly towards the Wounded figure and then attack if possible.

rows.name: 112. Inner Cavity
rows.text: This figure has one additional item slot. It can only be used on an item that only takes up one slot. The figure must spend an action retrieving this item before it can be used for the first time in a game (this action can replace a move action).

rows.name: 113. Cursed
rows.text: This figure is cursed by some higher power. It receives -1 to all Stat Rolls (rolls with a specific Target Number).

rows.name: 114. Foresight
rows.text: This figure is blessed with visions of the future. If you ever roll a natural "20" for initiative, this figure gains an extra action on its next activation.

rows.name: 115. Concentration Leech
rows.text: It is difficult to concentrate when this figure is near. Any figure attempting to cast a spell suffers -1 to the Casting Roll if this figure is within 3" and line of sight.

rows.name: 116. Glimpses of Doom
rows.text: This figure is cursed with glimpses of its own doom. If you ever roll a natural "20" for initiative, this figure receives no actions in its next activation.

rows.name: 117. Extra Heavy
rows.text: This figure suffers double damage from falls.

rows.name: 118. Poisonous Warts
rows.text: This figure is covered in poisonous warts. Whenever it takes damage in melee combat, all other figures in the combat must make a Will Roll (TN10) or be poisoned.

rows.name: 119. Withered Leg
rows.text: One of this figure's legs has withered to the point where it is almost unusable. Treat the figure as though it has the Smashed Leg permanent injury.

rows.name: 120. Quills
rows.text: This figure's body is covered in quills or spines. Whenever a figure in melee combat with this figure rolls a natural "1 - 2" on its Combat Roll, it suffers 2 points of damage in addition to whatever damage it would take if it loses the combat.

rows.name: 121. Puncture Weakened Skin
rows.text: If this figure ever suffers damage from a non-area effect, non-template shooting attack, it suffers +1 damage.

rows.name: 122. Vestigial Wings
rows.text: This figure has wings that are essentially useless. This figure must have specially fitted armour that costs an extra 50gc. If this figure is a soldier, this amount must be paid, or the figure loses the benefits of its armour.

rows.name: 123. Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a horse. Its Move stat is now 8, but it cannot climb ladders or other vertical terrain.

rows.name: 124. Furious Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +3 to its Combat Roll in a melee combat that it initiates. This decision must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 125. Painless
rows.text: This figure never feels pain. It gains the Never Wounded trait but has its Armour stat reduced by 1 to represent its lack of avoiding injury.

rows.name: 126. Improved Smell
rows.text: This figure counts as having the True Sight trait for all figures within 8".

rows.name: 127. Spatially Unstable
rows.text: Whenever this rolls a natural "1" for any roll, it suddenly jumps to a new location. Move the figure 6" in a random direction, placing it as close to that spot as is practical. The figure does suffer the results of the "1" (such as taking damage in combat) unless it resulted in movement.

rows.name: 128. Armoured Shell
rows.text: This figure has some sort of shell covering a large part of its body. This figure cannot wear any armour but gains +2 Armour.

rows.name: 129. Owl Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of an Owl. It gains +2 Will.

rows.name: 130. Magic Resistant
rows.text: This figure gains +1 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 131. Limb Rearrangement
rows.text: This figure's limbs are rearranged around its body in an odd fashion, which can confuse opponents in combat. The first Combat Roll each specific figure makes while in melee combat against this opponent each game suffers a -1 penalty.

rows.name: 132. Magic Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure suffers -1 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 133. Jittery
rows.text: This figure is always moving, even when sitting or lying down. This makes it especially hard to target. The figure receives +1 to all Combat Rolls against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 134. Emaciated
rows.text: This figure is very thin and scrawny. It suffers -1 Armour.

rows.name: 135. No Head
rows.text: This figure has no head, and all its facial features are in its chest. If this figure wears armour it is effectively, blind, dumb, and deaf, unless it has another means of using these senses.

rows.name: 136. Death Curse
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls on the Survival Table, it must roll three dice and select the lowest.

rows.name: 137. Covered in Fungus
rows.text: This figure is covered in strange fungus that repels most creatures. Uncontrolled creatures will never move towards or into combat with this figure if there are any other eligible figures. Uncontrolled creatures will still force combat if the figure moves within 1".

rows.name: 138. Telekinetic Push
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN20). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 3" directly away from the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 139. Hair of Snakes
rows.text: This figure always counts as armed with a dagger. If it attacks with that dagger, its attacks are poisonous.

rows.name: 140. Wheels
rows.text: This figure has wheels instead of feet. It gains +1 Move, but -5 to all Move Stat Rolls.

rows.name: 141. Explosive Sneeze
rows.text: This figure has highly volatile sneezes. If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" on an Initiative Roll, this figure sneezes, and all other figures within 2" immediately suffer a +1 shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 142. Massive Ears
rows.text: The figure has massive ears which improve its hearing. The figure gains the True Sight trait with a range of 4".

rows.name: 143. Mirror Face
rows.text: This figure's face always appears to be the same as the face of the observer, which is very disconcerting. Any figure that wishes to move into combat with this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN10) or it stops 1" away and its activation ends immediately.

rows.name: 144. Steady Hands
rows.text: This figure can keep its hands steady even in the most difficult of circumstances. It gains a permanent +1 to its Shoot Stat.

rows.name: 145. Short Legs
rows.text: This figure has shorter than average legs. It suffers -1 Move.

rows.name: 146. Animal Allergy
rows.text: This figure suffers extreme allergic reactions to animals. Whenever it is in combat with an animal, it suffers -2 Fight.

rows.name: 147. Weak
rows.text: This figure does half damage (rounded up) in melee combat.

rows.name: 148. Extremely Hairy
rows.text: This figure has a massive amount of hair, making it difficult to determine where its actual body lies. Figures receive -1 to all Shooting attacks against this figure if the figure is not wearing heavy armour.

rows.name: 149. Balancing Tail
rows.text: This figure has a tail that gives it near-perfect balance. If the figure is ever called upon to make a Move Roll to avoid falling, it passes automatically without having to roll.

rows.name: 150. Zombie-Reanimation
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place an uncontrolled zombie at the point it fell.

rows.name: 151. Trophy
rows.text: This figure has some mutation that others find valuable, such as a golden horn. It gains the Bounty (20gc) trait.

rows.name: 152. Body of Glass
rows.text: The figure's body is composed completely of glass. Reduce its Armour Stat by 3.

rows.name: 153. Death Scream
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, all figures within 6" immediately suffer a +0 attack.

rows.name: 154. Exoskeleton
rows.text: The figure has a tough exoskeleton, but no inner-skeleton. It gains +2 Armour but -3 Health. The figure may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 155. Insect Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of an insect. It gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 156. Extra Hand
rows.text: The figure has an extra hand somewhere on its body. The figure gains one additional item slot.

rows.name: 157. Soul-Bonded
rows.text: Select one other random member of the warband. This figure is soul-bonded to it and gains +1 Health. If that figure is reduced to 0 Health, then this figure is also immediately reduced to 0 Health. The reverse is not true. If the figure this figure is bonded to is killed, or leaves the warband, a substitute should be randomly selected.

rows.name: 158. Grows with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it gains +1 Fight and +1 Damage for the rest of the game. This bonus can only be gained once per game.

rows.name: 159. Highly Toxic
rows.text: This figure gives off a radioactive aura. All of its melee attacks count as poisonous.

rows.name: 160. Shrinks with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Damage for the rest of the game. This penalty can only be suffered once per game.

rows.name: 161. No Torso
rows.text: This figure essentially has no torso, its head rises out of its pelvis and its arms come out of the thighs. Its ungainly nature makes it difficult to fight. All figures suffer -1 Fight against it. This figure may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 162. Spontaneous Healer
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls a natural "20" on any Stat Roll, Combat Roll, or Casting Roll it immediately gains back up to 2 points of lost Health.

rows.name: 163. Slippery
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to force combat with this figure must first pass a Move Roll (TN16). If the roll is failed, the figure may not force combat, but may attempt to do so against another figure later in the turn.

rows.name: 164. Hard to Kill
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls on the Survival Table it must roll two dice and select the highest result.

rows.name: 165. Tinted Membrane
rows.text: This figure has a second set of eyelids that are tinted and translucent. This figure is immune to the Blinding Light Spell and any other effects of bright light.

rows.name: 166. Gigantic Horns
rows.text: This figure gains the Horns trait and always counts as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 167. Brace
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may increase its Armour by 3 for the duration of one attack, but the decision to use this ability must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 168. Immune to Curses
rows.text: This figure is immune to the Curse spell.

rows.name: 169. Bat Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a bat and can use echolocation. It never suffers any line-of-sight penalties due to darkness. It also gains the True Sight trait.

rows.name: 170. Beaver Tail
rows.text: This figure has a large, beaver-like tail. The figure gains +3 on all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 171. Inflate
rows.text: This figure can inflate its body to a significant size. Every time it activates, it can state if it is inflating. This is a free action. If inflated, the figure stays this way until its next activation. While inflated, the figure can fall any distance and suffers no damage and passes all Swimming Rolls automatically. However, it also suffers -4 Armour while inflated.

rows.name: 172. Eyes in Hands
rows.text: This figure must always have one hand free to see. It cannot carry 2-handed weapons or weapons that take up more than 1 gear slot. It can draw line of sight around a corner if it is within 0.5" of that corner.

rows.name: 173. Cat Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a large cat. It no longer suffers any movement penalties for rough terrain and its Move Stat is set at 7.

rows.name: 174. Small Antennae
rows.text: This figure has small antennae which help it perceive the world. It gains +1 Will.

rows.name: 175. Dazzling Aura
rows.text: Any figure that activates within 3" of this figure must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be dazzled for the remainder of the turn. While dazzled, the figure suffers -1 to all rolls. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 176. Must Move
rows.text: If this figure activates while not in combat, has at least one action, and does not spend an action to move, it immediately suffers 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 177. Body of Rock
rows.text: The figure's body is composed completely of rock. Its Armour Stat is increased by 3, but it may no longer wear armour of any type.

rows.name: 178. Slider
rows.text: This figure excretes oil on the undersides of its feet. It gains +2 Move during move actions, but only if it makes a move in a straight line, unimpeded by any terrain or other figures.

rows.name: 179. Hump
rows.text: This figure has a large hump like a camel. Before each game, this figure can consume one potion and store it in its hump. The figure may consume this potion to gain its effect whenever it activates without spending an action. If not consumed, the potion may be carried over to future games.

rows.name: 180. Webbed Hands or Feet
rows.text: The figure grows webs between its fingers, toes, or both. It automatically passes all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 181. Excretes Gems
rows.text: After every game in which the figure participates and survives, roll a die. On a 12+ it excretes a gem worth 10gc.

rows.name: 182. Pin Head
rows.text: This figure has an unusually small head. It suffers -1 Will.

rows.name: 183. Chicken Feet
rows.text: This figure has large, powerful, bird-like feet. This includes vicious talons. This figure always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 184. Project Self
rows.text: This figure can spend an action and immediately move 6" in any direction, so long as the final spot is in line of sight. This can move this figure into or out of combat. The figure may now use any other actions it has. However, as soon as this figure has completed its activation, move it back to the point where it activated.

rows.name: 185. Imp-Spawn
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place an uncontrolled imp on the spot where the figure fell.

rows.name: 186. Back Stabber
rows.text: This figure gains an additional +1 Fight whenever it can claim a support bonus from another figure. However, this figure never gives a support bonus to any other figure.

rows.name: 187. Nerves of Steel
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +4 to one Will Roll. It must decide to use this ability before the die is rolled.

rows.name: 188. Phasing
rows.text: This figure can temporarily phase out of this plane of existence, allowing it to move through walls and other solid structures. This figure gains the Burrowing trait.

rows.name: 189. Shot Magnet
rows.text: This figure suffers -1 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 190. Lunging Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may force combat with a figure that moves within 2" of it, instead of the normal 1".

rows.name: 191. Bouncy
rows.text: Whenever this figure falls or jumps, it may move 1" horizontally for each 2" fallen vertically to represent the bounce. Additionally, it takes only half damage from falling.

rows.name: 192. Fog Form
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to activate its fog form. For the rest of that activation and all of the next, it gains the Levitate trait, and no figure may force combat with it. However, the figure may not attack any other figure or pick up treasure tokens. If the figure was carrying a treasure token it is dropped at the point the figure activated the fog form.

rows.name: 193. Free Mover
rows.text: This figure is immune to the Petrify and Slow spells.

rows.name: 194. Wolf Companion
rows.text: This figure gains a wolf as a companion. This wolf counts as a member of the warband but does not take up a soldier slot. It may never intentionally move more than 6" away from its companion figure. If it activates more than 6" away, it must make a move directly towards its companion if possible. If the wolf is ever killed, another takes its place for the next game.

rows.name: 195. Demon Bane
rows.text: This figure's mere existence is painful to demons. Any time a demon moves within 1" of this figure, or activates while within 1", it suffers 1 point of damage. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 196. Mind Punch
rows.text: Whenever this figure makes an attack in melee combat, it may force its opponent to use its Will stat instead of its Fight stat for its Combat Roll. Otherwise, the combat follows the normal rules.

rows.name: 197. Always Visible
rows.text: This figure is immune to any effect that would turn it invisible.

rows.name: 198. Ethereal Vision
rows.text: This figure may draw line of sight through one piece of terrain, though it may not make any shooting attacks through that terrain.

rows.name: 199. Rat Attracter
rows.text: If this figure is on the table when the controlling player rolls a 1 - 3 for its Initiative Roll, place a giant rat on the table at a random point along the table edge.

rows.name: 200. Snake Arms
rows.text: This figure has snakes for arms. It may not carry any weapons or shields of any type. However, it always counts as armed with a poisonous hand weapon.

rows.name: 201. Hole in Chest
rows.text: This figure has a large hole in its chest. Whenever it rolls a natural "1" when rolling against an incoming shooting attack that would hit, that shot passes straight through the hole, causing no damage of any type.

rows.name: 202. Focus
rows.text: This figure is capable of incredible focus. Once per game, it can "focus" on a task and gain +5 to one Stat Roll (any roll with a specific Target Number). The decision to use this ability must be made before the die is rolled.

rows.name: 203. Temporary Amorphousness
rows.text: Once per game, when this figure activates, it may declare that it is amorphous. While amorphous, it may move through any hole no matter how small, and it suffers no penalty for moving over rough ground. This lasts until the end of the figure's activation. When this figure becomes amorphous, it drops any treasure tokens it was carrying and may not pick up any.

rows.name: 204. Eater of the Dead
rows.text: This figure likes to consume a portion of all its kills. Any figure reduced to 0 Health by this figure in melee combat suffers -1 to its Survival Roll after the game.

rows.name: 205. Hardened Soul
rows.text: This figure is immune to the Strike Dead spell.

rows.name: 206. Web Producer
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to create a web. This web can be up to 6" long, must be anchored at both ends on terrain, and some portion of the web must be adjacent to the figure. The web does not block line of sight; however, no figure may move through, or climb over a web. The web can be destroyed by a melee attack or a shooting attack that covers an area. Treat the web as having Fight +0, Armour 14, Health 1. Unless destroyed, the web remains until the end of the game.

rows.name: 207. Dog Head
rows.text: The figure has the head of a dog, including its powerful bite. This figure always counts as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 208. Enlarged Arms
rows.text: The figure has oversized and over muscled arms. It gains +1 damage in melee combat.

rows.name: 209. High Metabolism
rows.text: This figure burns calories extremely quickly and thus tends to run out of energy. This figure always counts as wounded after the fifth turn of the game.

rows.name: 210. Explosion Resistant
rows.text: Any attack that affects an area, instead of an individual target, does -3 damage against this figure.

rows.name: 211. Evil Eye
rows.text: The figure has a third eye which can command death. Once per game, it can spend an action to automatically cast the Strike Dead Spell with a Casting Roll of 14. As per the spell, this figure takes 1 damage using this ability.

rows.name: 212. Heavy Feet
rows.text: This figure has abnormally large, and very heavy, feet. It suffers -1 Move and -2 on Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 213. Mouth in Stomach
rows.text: This figure has no mouth on its face, instead it has a large mouth in its stomach. This figure never counts as unarmed and does +2 damage in melee combat provided it is not wearing any armour. Additionally, if it is wearing armour, it may not cast spells or take any other action that requires a verbal component.

rows.name: 214. Fully Rotatable Head
rows.text: This figure's head can spin around 360 degrees, making it more difficult to gang up against. Supporting figures only grant a +1 bonus when fighting this figure, instead of the normal +2.

rows.name: 215. Three-Scrawny Arms
rows.text: This figure has three arms or arm-like appendages, that are all weaker than normal. This figure does -1 damage in melee combat. It may use a two-handed weapon or staff at the same time as a shield. Alternatively, it may carry gear that takes up two slots and another that takes up one at the same time.

rows.name: 216. Perfect Balance
rows.text: Whenever this figure must make any roll to avoid falling, it passes the roll automatically.

rows.name: 217. Iron Heart
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +2 to a Will Roll. It may decide to use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 218. Wererat
rows.text: The figure is half-human, half-rat. It gains +1 Move, -1 Armour, -1 Will, -1 Health.

rows.name: 219. Poor Eyesight
rows.text: This figure has a maximum line of sight of 16".

rows.name: 220. Air Sack
rows.text: The figure gains an air sack, which may be internal or external to its original body. The figure gains +2 to all Swimming Rolls. It may draw air from this sack at any time, meaning it never suffers damage from drowning and can choose whether or not to suffer any effects from breathing, such as not breathing poison gas.

rows.name: 221. Punishing Blow
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure inflicts damage in melee combat, it may use this ability to inflict an extra 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 222. Small
rows.text: This figure is about half the size of a normal human. It receives +1 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 223. Stout Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a short, sturdy horse. Its Move stat is now 7, but it cannot climb ladders or other vertical terrain. It also never counts as unarmed, as it can make a kick attack.

rows.name: 224. Fully Rotatable Wrists
rows.text: This figure's wrists can spin around 360 degrees, which often allows it to make surprising attacks. Anytime this figure rolls an even number on an Attack Roll in melee combat, it gains an additional +1.

rows.name: 225. Empowering Will
rows.text: This figure may spend its own Health to increase any Will Roll it makes on a 1-for-1 basis.

rows.name: 226. Electrically Infused
rows.text: This figure has electricity running through its veins. Any figure that causes damage to this figure in melee combat immediately suffers a +0 magic attack (increase to +1 if it is wearing heavy armour).

rows.name: 227. Rooted
rows.text: Once per game, when a figure would be pushed back in combat, or moved by some other special effect, it can use this ability. The figure is not moved, if it is in combat, the other figure must step back instead.

rows.name: 228. Desperate Strike
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +3 to any Combat Roll. However, it then suffers -3 Fight for the rest of game.

rows.name: 229. Bright Plumage
rows.text: This figure has bright, colourful feathers that cannot be completely covered. The figure gains +2 Will, but -1 Fight against all incoming shooting attacks.

rows.name: 230. Werefly
rows.text: This figure is half-human, half-fly. It suffers -1 Move, -1 Fight, -1 Armour and -2 Health, but gains the Flying trait.

rows.name: 231. Mystic Hands
rows.text: This figure's melee attacks count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 232. Rock Eater
rows.text: This figure can very quickly consume rock, earth, and other common minerals and quickly expel them out the other end. This figure gains the Burrowing trait.

rows.name: 233. Enchanted Blood
rows.text: If this figure is below its starting Health, all its attacks count as magic attacks. This figure may spend an action to cut itself for 1 point of damage.

rows.name: 234. Back Plates
rows.text: This figure has large, bony plates growing out of its back, that gives it some degree of protection from behind. The first supporting figure bonus claimed by any enemy grants only a +1 bonus instead of the normal +2.

rows.name: 235. Incredibly Long Tongue
rows.text: This figure has an incredibly long tongue. It can make Shooting attacks with the tongue up to a range of 3" doing +0 damage.

rows.name: 236. Retractable Claws
rows.text: This figure has small, hooked claws that it can retract into its fingers. This figure suffers no penalties for fighting while unarmed. Additionally, it gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 237. Steady Hand
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +3 to one shooting attack, but the decision to use this ability must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 238. Obese
rows.text: This figure is extremely fat. It suffers -1 Move but +1 Health.

rows.name: 239. Minor Magic Immunity
rows.text: Whenever a spell is cast on this figure, or the effect of a spell would target this figure, roll a die. On a 15+ that spell has no effect on this figure.

rows.name: 240. Mystic Eye
rows.text: This figure's shooting attacks count as magic shooting attacks.

rows.name: 241. Officer of the Dead
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to cast Raise Zombie. The spell is automatically successful.

rows.name: 242. Troll Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled snow troll. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 243. Puppet Hand
rows.text: This figure has one hand replaced by a small version of itself from the torso upwards. This figure may not wield two-handed weapons, a staff, bow or crossbow, nor may it use a shield. It can, however, draw line of sight around a corner, if it is standing within 0.5" of that corner.

rows.name: 244. Overawed
rows.text: This figure does -1 damage against figures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 245. Demonic Prison
rows.text: Any time a demon moves into contact with this figure, or activates while in contact with this figure, it must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be imprisoned within the figure. This figure may only imprison one demon at a time, so if it already has one imprisoned, this rule does not apply. A figure may release an imprisoned demon at any time by spending an action and must place that demon within 3". Alternatively, the demon can be released after the game in which case it runs off.

rows.name: 246. Targeted Strike
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a natural "19" on a melee combat attack, it may convert this to a natural "20" and thus a critical hit.

rows.name: 247. Detachable Spines
rows.text: This figure has long spines growing from its body which it can detach and even throw. This figure always counts as armed with a dagger and has a 6" shooting attack doing -1 damage.

rows.name: 248. Tooth Spitter
rows.text: This figure can spit its own teeth at its enemies and rapidly regrow them. This figure may make shooting attacks with a range of 4" doing +0 damage.

rows.name: 249. Ink Spray
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spray ink at an opponent. Treat the figure as though it had just cast a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 14. This isn't actually a magic effect, and the effects cannot be cancelled by effects that cancel magic.

rows.name: 250. Beast Call
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to summon a nearby beast. Immediately roll on the Random Encounter Table and place the creature at a random point on the table edge. It is an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 251. Undead Allergy
rows.text: This figure suffers extremely allergic reactions to the undead. Whenever it is in combat with an undead creature, it suffers -2 Fight.

rows.name: 252. Crumbling Touch
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to automatically cast the Crumble Spell against a terrain feature within 1".

rows.name: 253. Must Move Quickly
rows.text: If this figure activates while not in combat, has at least one action, and does not spend an action to move, it immediately suffers 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 254. Beast Commander
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to target any uncontrolled animal within line of sight. That animal must make a Will Roll (TN20). If it fails, the figure may move the animal up to its Move stat in inches in any direction, including out of or into combat, so long as this move does not result in the animal taking immediate damage (such as walking off a cliff).

rows.name: 255. Wereboar
rows.text: This figure is half-man, half-boar. It gains +2 Health and the Tusks trait (use Horns trait).

rows.name: 256. Extra Forearms
rows.text: This figure has two arms, but four forearms, with extra forearms growing out at the elbows. This allows the figure to carry one additional item, or to fight with a two-handed weapon while also using a shield.

rows.name: 257. Random Pain
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls a natural "1" on any Stat Roll, Combat Roll, or Casting Roll, it immediately suffers 2 points of damage, though this cannot take a figure below 1 Health.

rows.name: 258. Wise Cyclops
rows.text: This figure can see more clearly with one eye than most can with two. The figure suffers the same penalties as for the Lost Eye permanent injury but gains +3 Will.

rows.name: 259. Extra Finger
rows.text: This figure has an extra finger somewhere on its body. It can wear one magic ring without the ring counting towards its maximum number of items.

rows.name: 260. Killer's Strength
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains +1 Fight for the rest of the game. It may only claim this bonus once per game.

rows.name: 261. Fish Slayer
rows.text: This figure does +5 damage on melee attacks against creatures with the Aquatic or Amphibious traits.

rows.name: 262. Albino
rows.text: The figure has no skin pigment, so that its skin is completely white, and its eyes are pink. This figure has a maximum line of sight of 18".

rows.name: 263. Reflective Skin
rows.text: This figure has reflective skin which makes it confusing to look at and difficult to target at a distance. It gains +2 Fight against all shooting attacks from another figure.

rows.name: 264. Mandibles
rows.text: This figure has a large pair of mandibles near its mouth which it can use to attack opponents. This figure always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 265. Bright Flash
rows.text: This figure occasionally flashes with bright light. Whenever a figure activates while in combat with this figure, it must immediately make a Will Roll (TN10) or suffer -3 Fight (to a minimum of +0) for the rest of its activation.

rows.name: 266. Heightened Magic Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 267. Poisonous Fur
rows.text: This figure is covered in fur which is poisonous if it gets into wounds. All this figure's melee attacks count as poisonous.

rows.name: 268. Evade
rows.text: Once per game, when this figure activates, it may move 1" in any direction as a free action, regardless of whether it is in combat. No figure may force combat as a result of this move.

rows.name: 269. Acrophobic
rows.text: This figure has an acute fear of heights. Anytime this figure wants to move up any terrain over 1" above the ground it must first pass a Will Roll (TN16). If it fails, it loses an action. The figure may make as many attempts to climb as it wishes, but it loses an action each time it fails.

rows.name: 270. Sickness Carrier
rows.text: This figure carries a chronic sickness. It suffers -2 Health. However, it does +1 damage in melee combat as its infection worsens the wounds of others. This extra damage does not apply to undead or constructs.

rows.name: 271. Light Discharge
rows.text: This figure can discharge an intense light. Once per game, this figure may spend an action to discharge its light. All other figures within 6" are treated as though the target of a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Number of 14.

rows.name: 272. Mild Addiction
rows.text: This figure is addicted to some substance and must spend 10gc before each game or suffer -1 to its starting Health due to withdrawal.

rows.name: 273. Death Dancer
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it is compelled to do a ritual dance. If it is active, its activation ends immediately. Either way, it receives no actions the next time it activates, but instead regains up to 3 points of lost Health.

rows.name: 274. Brightly Coloured
rows.text: This figure is brightly coloured with spots, stripes, or other patterns. At the start of a game, this figure may choose to be uncovered or covered. If it is covered, it suffers -1 Will. If it is uncovered, it gains +2 Will, but all shooting attacks against it are a +1.

rows.name: 275. Hunchback
rows.text: This figure has a severely hunched back and suffers -1 Move.

rows.name: 276. Ink Spew
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spray ink in all directions. Treat the figure as though it had just cast a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 14 against every other figure within 3". This is not actually a spell, and the effects cannot be cancelled by effects that cancel magic.

rows.name: 277. Low Preservation Sense
rows.text: This figure believes a little too strongly in its own immortality. This figure never receives any bonuses for being in cover.

rows.name: 278. Improved Vision
rows.text: This figure's vision is well above average. It gains a permanent +1 to its Shoot stat.

rows.name: 279. Troglodyte
rows.text: This figure is used to living underground, and its eyes have adapted to the dark. It never suffers any reduction in the maximum line of sight due to darkness. If outside in the daylight, however, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 280. Butterfly Wings
rows.text: This figure has large, fragile wings. It gains the Flying trait but loses this ability as soon as it falls below its starting Health.

rows.name: 281. Backswing
rows.text: Once per game, if this model wins a fight in melee combat, it may make another free attack against the same model without spending an action.

rows.name: 282. Duckbill
rows.text: This figure has a large duckbill for a mouth which can make it difficult to talk. It suffers -1 to all Casting Rolls.

rows.name: 283. Thick Eye Stalks
rows.text: The figure's eyes project far outside or above its head, allowing it easier vision in all direction. This figure receives +1 Fight when making Combat Rolls against shooting attacks and may reroll any Survival Roll that results in the Lost Eye permanent injury.

rows.name: 284. Poisonous Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has numerous tentacles which it can use to grapple and entrap enemies. An opponent fighting this figure in melee can only push it back or step back if it does damage; simply winning the combat is not enough. This figure's melee attacks are also poisonous.

rows.name: 285. Very Slippery
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to force combat with this figure must first pass a Move Roll (TN18). If the roll is failed, the figure may not force combat, but may attempt to do so against another figure later in the turn.

rows.name: 286. Fast Undead
rows.text: The figure gains the Undead trait and +1 Move.

rows.name: 287. Flesh Sheath
rows.text: This figure has a special pocket or pouch built into its body that can hold a weapon. This figure may carry one extra weapon that takes up no more than one item slot.

rows.name: 288. Evaporating Blood
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, its blood evaporates into a misty pink cloud. Place a 2" diameter cloud centred on the figure. This cloud blocks all line of sight but not movement. At the end of each turn, roll a die. On a 1 - 5 the cloud disperses.

rows.name: 289. Armoured Beard-Plate
rows.text: This figure has an armoured plate growing out of the bottom of its jaw that gives it some protection. This figure gains +1 Armour.

rows.name: 290. Wilful Ignorance
rows.text: Due to a general lack of perception of the world around it, this figure automatically passes the first Will Roll it is required to make each game.

rows.name: 291. Whiskers
rows.text: This figure has long whiskers allowing it to sense things close by that it cannot see. It gains True Sight with a range of 3".

rows.name: 292. Empathetic
rows.text: Whenever another figure within 6" rolls a natural "20" on any roll this figure gains back 1 lost point of Health. However, if a figure within 6" is reduced to 0 Health, this figure immediately suffers 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 293. Blood Pact
rows.text: This figure has made a deal with a demonic entity. Before each game, the figure may choose to suffer 3 points of damage. If it does not, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Shoot for the coming game. If it does suffer the damage, it gains +3 Will for the coming game.

rows.name: 294. Head on Arm
rows.text: This figure's head is at the end of one of its arms. It thus only has one hand and may not use a two-handed weapon, staff, shield, bow, or crossbow.

rows.name: 295. No Circulation
rows.text: This figure's blood does not circulate. Thus, it has the Immune to Poison trait.

rows.name: 296. Vomit Giant Insects
rows.text: This figure can vomit up large insects to attack its enemies. Treat the figure as having the Animate Skull spell with a Casting Number of 10. The "skulls" are actually large insects and thus have the Animal instead of Undead trait. Otherwise, they use the same stats. This figure may never improve this spell, nor counts as a spellcaster unless it already qualified.

rows.name: 297. Burning Bile
rows.text: This figure can vomit burning bile. This figure may make shooting attacks with a 3" range and +1 damage.

rows.name: 298. Killer's Toughness
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains +1 Armour for the rest of the game. This bonus can only be earned once per game.

rows.name: 299. Poison Healer
rows.text: Anytime this figure suffers damage from a poison attack, the damage is reduced by 2 points.

rows.name: 300. No Shock Absorption
rows.text: This figure lacks the means to mitigate damage from a fall. It suffers double damage from falls.

rows.name: 301. Motivated by Fear
rows.text: Whenever this figure uses the "Run For It" action it may move 5" instead of the normal 3".

rows.name: 302. Blubber
rows.text: This figure has a blubbery layer all around its body. It gains +1 Health and never suffers any penalties from scenario effects relating to cold.

rows.name: 303. Fly-Eyes
rows.text: This figure has eyes like a giant fly which give it a better vision of 3-dimensional space. This figure gains +1 Fight against all shooting attacks.

rows.name: 304. Shakes
rows.text: This figure shakes all the time. It suffers -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 305. Hippo Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a hippopotamus. It also gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 306. Extendable Breathing Tube
rows.text: This figure has a tube that extends from somewhere on its body that it can use to breathe while under water. It gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 307. No Organs
rows.text: This figure has no specific organs inside its body. It is Immune to Critical Hits.

rows.name: 308. Adrenaline Boost
rows.text: This figure gets charged up for a fight. It gains +1 to all die rolls it makes for the first three turns of the game. After that, it suffers -2 on all die rolls it makes for the remainder of the game.

rows.name: 309. Giraffe Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a giraffe and gains +1 Will.

rows.name: 310. Enchantment Scrubber
rows.text: At the end of every turn, roll a die for this figure. On an 11+ all spells currently active on the figure are cancelled.

rows.name: 311. Unlife Gnawer
rows.text: This figure feeds off the power of animate, non-living things. Whenever an undead or construct activates within 2", that figure immediately suffers 2 points of damage. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 312. Cheek Pouch
rows.text: This figure has extremely stretchy cheeks which it can use to store items. This figure may carry one extra item that takes up no more than one item slot.
