rows.name: 313. Turtle Shell
rows.text: This figure has a heavy turtle-like shell. It has a natural Armour Stat of 12 but may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 314. Werebear
rows.text: The figure is half-man, half-bear. It gains +1 Fight, +2 Health, does +1 damage, and gains the Large trait.

rows.name: 315. Hardened Exoskeleton
rows.text: The figure has a tough exoskeleton, but no inner skeleton. It gains +3 Armour but -5 Health. The figure may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 316. Large Cloud Release
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to release a cloud of dark gas. Place a 4" diameter cloud adjacent to the figure. The figure suffers 2 points of damage every time it does this. Line of sight may not be drawn through the cloud. At the end of each turn, roll a die for each cloud. On a 1 - 5 the cloud dissipates and should be removed from the table.

rows.name: 317. Boiling Blood Spray
rows.text: This figure has boiling hot blood that it can spray at opponents. This figure may spend an action to make a +3 shooting attack with +2 damage at a range of 10". However, it immediately takes 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 318. Construct Allergy
rows.text: This figure suffers extremely allergic reactions to constructs. Whenever it is in combat with a construct, it suffers -2 Fight.

rows.name: 319. Mana Battery (2)
rows.text: This figure produces mystical energy that can be tapped by friends who know how. If a figure in the same warband attempts to cast a spell within 3" of this figure it may draw upon this figure to add +2 to the roll. This can only be done once each game.

rows.name: 320. Ethereal Prison
rows.text: Any time an ethereal undead figure moves into contact with this figure, or activates while in contact with this figure, it must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be imprisoned within the figure. This figure may only imprison one ethereal undead at a time, so if it already has one imprisoned, this rule does not apply. A figure may release the ethereal undead at any time by spending an action and must place that creature within 3". Alternatively, the ethereal undead can be released after the game in which case it runs off.

rows.name: 321. External Lungs
rows.text: This figure's lungs are on the outside, increasing the likelihood of a blow doing critical damage. If its opponent rolls a natural "19" in melee combat, treat this as a "20" instead, causing a critical hit.

rows.name: 322. Shredding Blow
rows.text: Whenever this figure damages an opponent in melee combat, that opponent also suffers -1 Armour until the end of the game. This penalty is cumulative down to a minimum of Armour 10.

rows.name: 323. Blockhead
rows.text: The figure's head is shaped like a rectangular prism. It suffers -1 Will.

rows.name: 324. Limb-Stealer
rows.text: This figure can steal working limbs from corpses to replace its own. This figure never suffers from permanent injuries (except Never Quite as Strong or Psychological Scars) as it can just replace broken parts.

rows.name: 325. Mind Bash
rows.text: Whenever this figure makes an attack in melee combat, it may force its opponent to use its Will stat instead of its Fight stat for its Combat Roll. If the option is selected this figure gains +1 to its own Fight Roll. Otherwise, the combat follows the normal rules.

rows.name: 326. Giant Buckteeth
rows.text: This figure has two giant front teeth, like a beaver. It always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 327. Antennae
rows.text: This figure has antennae which help it perceive the world. It gains +2 Will.

rows.name: 328. Blood Eagle
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to half its Health or less (rounding down) it grows wings and gains the Flying trait for the rest of the scenario.

rows.name: 329. Empowering Dodge
rows.text: This figure may spend its own Health to increase any Combat Roll it makes against a shooting attack on a 1-for-1 basis.

rows.name: 330. Self-Projectile
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to make a shooting attack at a target up to 6" away. This attack does +2 damage. After the attack, move the shooting figure 1.5" away from the target in a random direction, and the shooting figure takes 2 points of damage. If the shooting figure is carrying a treasure token, it drops it at the point it made the shooting attack.

rows.name: 331. Mind Cloud
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to use this ability. For the remainder of the turn, no figure may force combat with this one.

rows.name: 332. Extendable Arms
rows.text: This figure may pick up a treasure token within 3" provided there is no enemy figure within 1" of either the figure or the token.

rows.name: 333. Very Long Neck
rows.text: This figure has a very elongated neck, which unfortunately makes it vulnerable. It takes +7 damage any time it suffers a critical hit (instead of the normal +5).

rows.name: 334. Snail Shell
rows.text: This figure has a large snail shell on its back. This figure receives +2 Armour but may not wear any armour. At the start of a turn, the figure can "retreat into its shell". For the rest of the turn, it gains +3 Armour (in addition to the normal +2 is already receives) and -3 Fight, and its Move is reduced to 2.

rows.name: 335. Improved Foresight
rows.text: This figure is blessed with visions of the future. If you ever roll a natural "19 - 20" for initiative, this figure gains an extra action on its next activation.

rows.name: 336. Blood-Enchanted
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it may sacrifice 1 Health as a free action. If done, all its attacks count as magic attacks until its next activation.

rows.name: 337. Sticky
rows.text: This figure secretes a sticky substance which makes it hard for creatures to escape combat. A figure in combat with this creature may only push it back or step back if it does damage; simply winning the combat is not enough.

rows.name: 338. Thick Armoured Shell
rows.text: This figure has some sort of shell covering most of its body. This figure cannot wear any armour but gains +3 Armour and -1 Move.

rows.name: 339. Continues to Shrink with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Damage for the rest of the game. This penalty can be suffered twice per game with the penalties stacking.

rows.name: 340. Poisonous Quills
rows.text: Parts of this figure's body are covered in quills or spines. Whenever a figure in melee combat with this figure rolls a natural "1 - 2" on its Combat Roll, it suffers 2 points of damage and is poisoned in addition to whatever damage it takes from losing the combat.

rows.name: 341. Powerful Icy Grasp
rows.text: This figure does +3 damage in melee combat. This bonus does not apply when in combat with undead or constructs.

rows.name: 342. Illusionary Appearance
rows.text: This figure appears beautiful until it is in combat when its true horrific appearance is revealed. Its opponent receives -2 Fight on its first Combat Roll against this figure each game. Undead, constructs, and figures with True Sight are immune to this penalty.

rows.name: 343. Strong Elemental Armour
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (4).

rows.name: 344. Mole Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a mole and gains the Burrowing trait.

rows.name: 345. Extended Reach
rows.text: The figure's arms are slightly longer than normal, giving it an advantage in melee combat. This figure gains +1 Fight when in combat.

rows.name: 346. Tough Undead
rows.text: The figure gains the Undead trait and +2 Health.

rows.name: 347. Addiction
rows.text: This figure is addicted to some substance and must spend 15gc before each game or suffer -2 to its starting Health due to withdrawal.

rows.name: 348. Minor Static Discharge
rows.text: Whenever this figure completes a Move action, the nearest other figure in line of sight suffers a -2 elemental magic shooting attack.

rows.name: 349. Will to Kill
rows.text: This figure can channel its will into killing strikes. This figure has +1 Will, and all the figure's melee attacks count as magic attacks for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 350. Duck Feet
rows.text: This figure has large, webbed feet, like a duck. It suffers -1 Move but gains +2 Move when in water and +5 on all swimming rolls.

rows.name: 351. Mitigation
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can reduce the damage from any one source by up to 5.

rows.name: 352. Weak-Willed Bleeder
rows.text: This figure loses 1 point of Health every time it activates if it is already below its maximum starting Health. This rule does not apply if the figure only has 1 point of Health remaining. Additionally, the figure suffers -2 Will when below starting Health.

rows.name: 353. Fungal Growth
rows.text: A significant portion of this figure is covered in fungal growth. It suffers -2 Health but gains the Never Wounded trait.

rows.name: 354. Thrashing Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has tentacles that whip around its body. Any time any figure (including friendly ones) moves or activates within 2" of this figure, the activating/moving figure suffers a +1 shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 355. Balancing Tail
rows.text: This figure has a tail which it can use to help with balance. It gains +4 on all Move Rolls.

rows.name: 356. Killer's Endurance
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health during the game, it gains 3 Health. This may take it over its starting Health, but only for the duration of this game. This only applies once per game.

rows.name: 357. Visions of the Future
rows.text: This figure receives infrequent visions of the future. If this figure is on the table, the player receives +1 to all Initiative Rolls.

rows.name: 358. Ghost Call
rows.text: This figure may spend an action, which can replace a move action, to scream. Roll a die. On a 19+ place a wraith at a random point along the table edge. On any other result, nothing happens, and the action is lost.

rows.name: 359. Dead Eye
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +1 to a shooting attack. It may decide to use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 360. Random Teleport
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to teleport 6" in a random direction. This may not move it off the table but can move it out of combat. Any treasure tokens carried by the figure are dropped at the point it teleported from.

rows.name: 361. Very Small
rows.text: This figure is about a quarter of the size of a normal human. It has -1 Fight and -2 Health but receives +5 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 362. Upside Down Head
rows.text: This figure has an upside-down head and sees the world from a slightly different perspective. It gains +1 Will.

rows.name: 363. Very Squishy
rows.text: This figure is just really soft. It suffers a permanent -2 Armour.

rows.name: 364. Snake Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a snake. It always counts as armed with a poisonous dagger.

rows.name: 365. Barbed Tail
rows.text: This figure has a tail covered in nasty barbs. It always counts as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 366. Brainless
rows.text: This figure lacks any identifiable brain. It is Immune to Suggestion and all Control spells.

rows.name: 367. Partial Magic Immunity
rows.text: Whenever a spell is cast on this figure, or the effect of a spell would target this figure, roll a die. On a 12+ that spell has no effect on this figure.

rows.name: 368. Surrounded by Bees
rows.text: This figure is constantly surrounded by bees or other flying, stinging insects. This figure and all other figures within 2" suffer -2 to all rolls. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 369. Poison Susceptibility
rows.text: This figure has violent reactions to poison. Whenever it suffers damage from a poisoned attack, it immediately suffers an additional 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 370. Dodge
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may increase its Armour by 3 for the duration of one combat. It may decide to use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 371. Undead Commander
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to target any uncontrolled undead within line of sight. That undead must make a Will Roll (TN20). If it fails, the figure may move the undead up to its Move stat in inches in any direction, including out of or into combat, so long as this move does not result in the undead taking immediate damage (such as walking off a cliff).

rows.name: 372. Nearly 2-Dimensional
rows.text: This figure is very flat, almost like paper. It has -1 Armour but can never suffer more than 4 points of non-magical damage from a bow, crossbow, or javelin attack.

rows.name: 373. Bounding Attack
rows.text: This figure can move an additional 4" on any move action that moves it into combat.

rows.name: 374. Glowing Eyes
rows.text: This figure's eyes glow with unearthly energy. It gains the True Sight trait.

rows.name: 375. Improved Magic Resistance
rows.text: This figure gains +2 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 376. Tortoise Shell
rows.text: This figure has a heavy tortoise-like shell. It has a natural Armour stat of 12 but may not wear any armour. The figure also gains Elemental Resistance (1).

rows.name: 377. Poison Gland
rows.text: This figure has a gland that secretes a small amount of poison. Before each game, the figure may select one weapon or one piece of ammunition (its own or another figure's in the same warband) to count as poisonous for the game.

rows.name: 378. Extremely Emaciated
rows.text: This figure is extremely thin and scrawny. It suffers -2 Armour.

rows.name: 379. Extra Eyes
rows.text: The figure has numerous extra eyes which helps with both field and depth of vision. The figure gains +1 Fight whenever it rolls against shooting attacks. Additionally, this figure can suffer the Lost Eye permanent injury limitless times without suffering any actual penalty.

rows.name: 380. Enchanted Eye
rows.text: One of this figure's eyes is twice as large as the other and glows. All its shooting attacks count as magic shooting attacks and do an additional 1 point of elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 381. Extremely Acidic Blood
rows.text: If this figure is damaged in melee combat, all other figures in the combat immediately suffer 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 382. Empowering Damage
rows.text: This figure may spend its own Health to increase the amount of damage inflicted when it wins a round of melee combat on a 1-for-1 basis, to a maximum of +5.

rows.name: 383. Doesn't Float
rows.text: For whatever reason, this figure doesn't float and suffers -5 to all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 384. Horrific Wail
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to wail. All figures within 6", except the active figure, must make a Will Roll (TN10) or suffer damage equal to the amount by which it failed the roll. Undead and constructs are immune to this damage, as are any figures that cannot hear.

rows.name: 385. Featureless Face
rows.text: This figure's face is completely blank and devoid of features, yet somehow all its senses remain intact. It suffers -2 Will and must reroll any Lost Eye permanent injuries.

rows.name: 386. Armoured Serpent Tale
rows.text: This figure has a serpent tail instead of legs. It suffers -1 Move but never suffers movement penalties for going over rough ground. Additionally, it gains a +1 Armour.

rows.name: 387. Disease Carrier
rows.text: This figure carries a chronic disease. It suffers a permanent -3 Health. Any figure that is damaged by this figure in melee combat must make a Health Roll (TN20). If it fails, it contracts a temporary form of the disease and starts the next game at -3 Health (cumulative with any other penalties).

rows.name: 388. Satyr
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a goat. When unarmed, this figure Fights at -2, but suffers no damage penalty. It also suffers -2 to all Move Stat Rolls.

rows.name: 389. Demon Purger
rows.text: This figure has an innate power to cast demons back to their own dimensions. Treat this figure as though it has the Banish spell with a Casting Number of 6. This ability may not be improved.

rows.name: 390. Poison Leech
rows.text: This figure has the Immune to Poison trait. Additionally, it can suck poison out of a wound with ease. If this figure is ever within 1" of a friendly figure that is not in combat, it may spend an action (which can replace a Move action) to remove the poisoned condition from the friendly figure.

rows.name: 391. Reposte
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +1 to a Combat Roll in melee combat. It may use this ability after the dice have been rolled.

rows.name: 392. Leg Tentacles with Suckers
rows.text: The figure's legs are replaced with a mass of tentacles. This figure never suffers movement penalties for movement over rough ground; however, the maximum distance it can jump horizontally is always reduced by 1". The figure suffers -1 Move but gains a +5 on any rolls to avoid falling.

rows.name: 393. Rough on Weapons
rows.text: This figure often breaks its own weapons. Whenever it rolls a natural "1" on a melee Combat Roll, the weapon it is using is broken and becomes useless. If the weapon is magical, it does not break, but it loses all bonuses and does not count as magical for the remainder of the game (though it still won't break because of this trait).

rows.name: 394. Nightmares of Doom
rows.text: This figure is cursed with nightmares of its own doom. If you ever roll a natural "19 - 20" for initiative, this figure receives a maximum of one action in its next activation.

rows.name: 395. Razor Mandibles
rows.text: This figure has a large pair of mandibles near its mouth which it can use to attack. This figure always counts as armed with a hand weapon that does +1 damage.

rows.name: 396. Stubby Legs
rows.text: This figure has very short legs. It suffers -1 Move.

rows.name: 397. Unlucky Shot Magnet
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Fight whenever it rolls against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 398. Rage Strength
rows.text: This figure does +2 damage in melee combat if it is below its starting Health.

rows.name: 399. Soul-Paired
rows.text: Select one other random member of the warband. This figure is soul-bonded to this one and gains +2 Health. If that figure is reduced to 0 Health, then this figure is also immediately reduced to 0 Health. The reverse is not true. If the bonded figure leaves the warband for any reason, another random warband member must be selected to takes its place.

rows.name: 400. Incredible Smell
rows.text: This figure counts as having True Sight with a maximum range of 16".

rows.name: 401. Double Hump
rows.text: This figure has two large humps like a camel. Before each game, this figure can drink one or two potions and store them in its humps. The figure may consume either potion to gain its effect whenever it activates without spending an action. If not consumed, these potions can be stored in the hump between games.

rows.name: 402. Angelic Pact
rows.text: This figure has made a deal with a higher entity. Before each game, it may choose to suffer -1 Fight and -1 Shoot for the coming game in exchange for +1 Armour and +3 Health.

rows.name: 403. Loud Soul
rows.text: If this figure is on the table whenever any player rolls to check for a random encounter, roll two dice and take the highest.

rows.name: 404. Very Brittle Bones
rows.text: This figure has a weak bone structure. It receives -2 to all Survival Rolls.

rows.name: 405. Gigantic Eyes
rows.text: This figure has eyes that are at least four times the normal size, which helps it see in low-light conditions. This figure never suffers any limitations to line of sight due to darkness.

rows.name: 406. Killer's Will
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health it gains +5 Will for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 407. Bone Ruff
rows.text: This figure has a large bone ruff which projects out from just below its head that helps protect it from hits to its vital spots. This figure is Immune to Critical Hits.

rows.name: 408. Commander of the Dead
rows.text: Twice per game, this figure can spend an action to cast Raise Zombie. The spell is automatically successful. The figure may only have one zombie in play at any time.

rows.name: 409. Continues to Grow with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it gains +1 Fight and +1 melee damage for the rest of the game. This bonus can be gained twice in a game, with the effects stacking.

rows.name: 410. External Heart
rows.text: This figure's heart is on the outside, increasing the likelihood of a blow doing critical damage. If an enemy figure rolls a "19" when attacking this figure, convert that to a "20" and a critical hit.

rows.name: 411. Vulnerability to Witchcraft
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to resist any spells from the Witch school.

rows.name: 412. Elemental Absorption
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (1). Additionally, whenever the figure is hit by an elemental attack that doesn't reduce it to 0 Health, it regains 1 point of lost Health.

rows.name: 413. Bright Butterfly Wings
rows.text: This figure has large, fragile wings. It gains the Flying trait but loses this ability as soon as it falls below its starting Health. Additionally, the figure is at -1 against all shooting attacks because it is such a large, bright target.

rows.name: 414. Crushing Blow
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure inflicts damage in melee combat, it may use this ability to inflict an extra 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 415. Ghoul Reanimation
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place an uncontrolled ghoul at the point it fell.

rows.name: 416. Sharpeye
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a natural "19" on a Shooting Roll, it may convert this to a "20" and a critical hit.

rows.name: 417. Severe Shakes
rows.text: This figure shakes severely all the time. It suffers -2 Shoot.

rows.name: 418. Eye Thief
rows.text: This figure can reach into a victim's mind and temporarily steal its sight. Once per game, this figure may spend an action to automatically cast Blinding Light against a figure within 10" and line of sight. Treat the spell as having a Casting Number of 16. Figures that are immune to Mind Control or Suggestion are immune to this power.

rows.name: 419. Super Slider
rows.text: This figure excretes oil on the undersides of its feet. It gains +3 Move, but only if it makes a move in a straight line, unimpeded by any terrain or other figures.

rows.name: 420. Mark of Power
rows.text: This figure has strange, runic birthmarks on the backs of its hands. All its melee combat attacks count as magic and do an additional 1 point of elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 421. Sneak Attack
rows.text: This figure gains an additional +2 Fight whenever it can claim a support bonus from another figure. However, this figure never gives a support bonus to any other figure.

rows.name: 422. Strong Telekinetic Pull
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN22). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 3" directly towards the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 423. Desperate Levitation
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may declare it has the Levitation ability. This can occur at any point; it does not have to be during the figure's activation and does not cost an action. The ability lasts until the end of the turn.

rows.name: 424. Extremely Poor Eyesight
rows.text: This figure has a maximum line of sight of 12".

rows.name: 425. Flaming Fists
rows.text: This figure can cause its fists to ignite in flames on command. This figure always counts as armed with a magical hand weapon that does +2 elemental damage.

rows.name: 426. Weak but Fast
rows.text: This figure has +1 Move and +1 Fight but does half damage (rounded up) in melee combat.

rows.name: 427. Extra-Sharp Beak
rows.text: This figure has a beak instead of a mouth and nose. It is always counted as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 428. Neck Frill
rows.text: This figure has a large frill that it can expand out from its neck. This makes it confusing to target with missile weapons. This figure gains +2 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 429. Giant Scorpion Tail
rows.text: This figure has a scorpion tail growing out of its body. This figure always counts as armed with a poisonous hand weapon that does +1 damage.

rows.name: 430. Vulnerability to Chronomancy
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to resist or break free from any spells in the Chronomancy school.

rows.name: 431. Death Strike
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a natural "18 or 19" on a melee combat attack, it may convert the roll to a "20" and a critical hit.

rows.name: 432. Barbs
rows.text: This figure has small barbs in its hands and arms that makes it difficult for enemies to escape its grasp. A figure fighting against this one may only push this figure back, or step back, if it causes damage from an attack; simply winning the combat is not enough.

rows.name: 433. Werespider
rows.text: This figure is half-man, half-spider. It suffers -1 Fight and -2 Health but gains the Expert Climber and Poison traits.

rows.name: 434. Vulnerability to Illusion
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to resist or break free from any spells in the Illusionist school.

rows.name: 435. Toxic Cloud Release
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to release a cloud of dark gas. Place a 2" diameter cloud adjacent to the figure. The figure suffers 2 points of damage every time it does this. Line of sight may not be drawn through the cloud. Any figure that moves through this cloud, apart from the figure that produced it, must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be poisoned. At the end of the turn, roll a die for each cloud, on a 1 - 5 the cloud is removed from the table.

rows.name: 436. Anteater Head
rows.text: The figure has the head of an anteater and gains +1 Will.

rows.name: 437. Crookback
rows.text: This figure has a severely crooked back. It suffers a permanent -1 Fight.

rows.name: 438. Telekinetic Drag
rows.text: This figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN20). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 3" directly towards the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 439. Faun
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a deer. This figure gains +1 Move, but -1 Health.

rows.name: 440. Improved Fog Form
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to activate its fog form. For the rest of that activation through to the end of the figure's next activation, it gains Move +4 and the Levitate trait, and no figure may force combat with it. However, the figure may not attack any other figure or pick up treasure tokens. If the figure was carrying a treasure token it is dropped at the point it activated the fog form.

rows.name: 441. Killer's Fury
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains +2 damage on all melee combat attacks for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 442. Extra Rude Finger
rows.text: This figure has an extra finger somewhere on its body. It can wear one magic ring without the ring counting towards its maximum number of items. Additionally, the finger is perfect for making rude gestures, which gives the figure +1 Will when rolling to resist spells.

rows.name: 443. Flaming Eyes
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to make a +2 elemental magic shooting attack doing +1 damage at a maximum range of 8".

rows.name: 444. Barbed Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has numerous tentacles which it can use to grapple and entrap enemies. It always counts as armed with a dagger. Additionally, enemy figures in combat with this figure may only push this figure back, or step back, if it causes damage in combat; simply winning a combat is not enough.

rows.name: 445. Vicious Dog Companion
rows.text: This figure gains a war hound as a companion. This hound does count as a member of the warband but does not take up a soldier slot. The war hound may never intentionally move more than 6" away from its companion figure. If it activates more than 6" away, it must make a move directly towards its companion if possible. Note that the same restriction does not apply to the actual figure, which can move away from the war hound with no limitations. If the war hound is killed, another will take its place before the next game.

rows.name: 446. Insanity
rows.text: If this figure ever rolls a natural "1 or 2" on any roll during the game, it goes temporarily insane and counts as an uncontrolled creature. This lasts for the rest of the turn on which the "1 or 2" was rolled and all the next turn. After that, the insanity passes, and the figure returns to its normal allegiance.

rows.name: 447. Greater Insanity
rows.text: If this figure ever rolls a "1" on any roll during the game, it goes insane and counts as an uncontrolled creature for the rest of the game. If it is carrying a treasure token, it immediately drops it. After the game, it returns to its normal allegiance.

rows.name: 448. Hammerhead Shark Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a hammerhead shark and gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 449. Excretes Valuable Gems
rows.text: After every game in which the figure participates and survives, roll a die. On a 15+ it excretes a gem worth 30gc.

rows.name: 450. Severe Addiction
rows.text: This figure is addicted to some substance and must spend 25gc before each game or suffer -1 to all die rolls during the game due to withdrawal.

rows.name: 451. Life Burn
rows.text: Any other figure that activates within 2" of this figure immediately suffers 2 points of damage. Undead and constructs are immune to this ability. This ability never applies on the first turn of a game.

rows.name: 452. Wilful Undead
rows.text: The figure gains the Undead trait and +2 Will.

rows.name: 453. Armoured Insect Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of an insect. It gains the Expert Climber trait and +1 Armour.

rows.name: 454. Beast Caller
rows.text: Twice per game, this figure may spend an action to summon any nearby beast. Immediately roll on the Random Encounter Table and place the creature at a random point on the table edge. It is an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 455. Telekinetic Slam
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN20). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 8" directly away from the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 456. Bird Slayer
rows.text: This figure does +5 damage on attacks against creatures with the Flying trait.

rows.name: 457. Giant Killer
rows.text: This figure does +2 damage against figures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 458. Undead Attracter
rows.text: If this figure is on the table when the controlling player rolls a "1 - 3" for its Initiative Roll, place a skeleton on the table at a random point along the table edge.

rows.name: 459. Mana Battery (1/1)
rows.text: This figure produces mystical energy that can be tapped by friends who know how. If a figure in the same warband attempts to cast a spell within 3" of this figure it may draw upon this figure to add +1 to the roll. This can be done twice each game.

rows.name: 460. Poisonous Pustules
rows.text: This figure is covered in poisonous pustules. Whenever it takes damage in melee combat, all other figures in the combat must make a Will Roll (TN14) or be poisoned.

rows.name: 461. Killer's Flight
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains the Flying trait for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 462. Ferocious Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +4 to its Combat Roll in a melee combat that it initiates. This decision must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 463. Intense Bloodboil
rows.text: This figure may supercharge its bloodflow. Before each game, it may choose to suffer 5 damage to gain +1 Fight and +1 Shoot.

rows.name: 464. Long Eye Stalks
rows.text: The figure's eyes project far outside or above its head, allowing it easier vision in all directions. This figure receives +1 Fight when making Combat Rolls against shooting attacks, and it may draw line of sight over terrain that is 1" or less above its head (though it cannot make shooting attacks over it unless its arms can also reach that high).

rows.name: 465. Greatly Extendable Neck
rows.text: This figure can extend its neck so that its head is up to 3" higher than it actually is. Thus, a figure can draw line of sight over objects that are less than 3" higher than it. It may use this to cast spells but not to make attacks, as its hands cannot reach that high (unless the attack is generated by the figure's head).

rows.name: 466. Scalding Blood Spray
rows.text: This figure has boiling hot blood that it can spray at opponents. This figure may spend an action to make a +4 shooting attack with +2 damage at a range of 10". However, it immediately takes 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 467. Empowering Speed
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it can spend its own Health to increase its Move for that activation. It costs 3 Health to increase Move by 1 or 5 Health to increase it by 2. This is the maximum it can be increased.

rows.name: 468. Gorilla Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled White Gorilla. The gorilla drops any treasure tokens the figure was carrying. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 469. Terrifying Appearance
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to move into combat with this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, the action is lost, and it may not move into combat with the figure this turn, though the figure may continue with its activation if it has other actions.

rows.name: 470. Powerful Random Teleport
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to teleport 8" in a random direction. This may not move it off the table but can move it out of combat. Any treasure tokens carried by the figure are dropped at the point it teleported from.

rows.name: 471. Fully Rotatable Elbows
rows.text: This figure's elbows can spin around 360 degrees, which often allows it to make surprising attacks. Anytime this figure rolls an even number on an attack roll in melee combat, it gains an additional +1 (except a "20" which stays as "20").

rows.name: 472. High Blood-Enchantment
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it may sacrifice 2 Health as a free action. If done, all its attacks count as magic attacks and do +2 damage until its next activation.

rows.name: 473. Decaying Touch
rows.text: This figure has an innate ability to rapidly age inanimate weapons. Treat the figure as though it has the Decay spell with a Casting Number of 8 and a maximum range of 3". The figure may not empower this roll nor improve the Casting Number.

rows.name: 474. Intense Blood Allergy
rows.text: This creature is allergic to the blood of other creatures. If it ever damages another creature in melee combat, it suffers 2 points of damage and is poisoned. This does not apply if the creature damaged doesn't bleed, such as undead and constructs.

rows.name: 475. Bright Form
rows.text: Any opposing figure that wants to make a shooting attack of any type against this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN8). If it fails, it is blinded for the remainder of the turn, and its stats are reduced to Move 1, Fight +0, Shoot +0.

rows.name: 476. Highly Reflective Skin
rows.text: This figure has reflective skin which makes it confusing to look at and difficult to target at a distance. It gains +3 Fight against all shooting attacks from another figure (but not scenario special effects).

rows.name: 477. Spiked Snail Shell
rows.text: This figure has a large snail shell on its back. This figure receives +2 Armour but may not wear any armour. At the start of a turn, the figure can "retreat into its shell". Until the start of its next activation, the figure gains +3 Armour (in addition to the normal +2) and -3 Fight, and its Move is reduced to 2. This figure always counts as armed with a dagger due to the spikes on its shell.

rows.name: 478. Nerves of Adamant
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +7 to one Will Roll. It must decide to use this ability before the die is rolled.

rows.name: 479. Hair of Vipers
rows.text: This figure has a nest of snakes instead of hair. It always counts as armed with a poisonous hand weapon.

rows.name: 480. Vulnerability to Necromancy
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to resist or break free from spells from the Necromancy school.

rows.name: 481. Double Backswing
rows.text: Twice per game, if this model wins a fight in melee combat, it may make another free attack against the same model without spending an action. The figure may still only use this ability once per activation.

rows.name: 482. Concentration Parasite
rows.text: It is difficult to concentrate when this figure is close. Any figure attempting to cast a spell suffers a -1 to the Casting Roll if this figure is within 6" and line of sight. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 483. Killer's Speed
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains +2 Move for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 484. Gigantic Brain
rows.text: This figure has a gigantic brain, meaning its head is much larger than normal. Any time the figure rolls a natural "18 - 20" on a Will Roll, the roll counts as an automatic success.

rows.name: 485. Vulnerability to Mental Control
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to all attempts to resist or break free from spells from the Soothsayer school.

rows.name: 486. Vicious Cat Centaur
rows.text: This figure has the bottom half of a large vicious cat. It no longer suffers any movement penalties for rough terrain and its Move stat is set at 7. Additionally, it never counts as unarmed due to natural claws that do +1 damage.

rows.name: 487. Morbidly Obese
rows.text: This figure is horrifically fat. It suffers -2 Move but has +3 Health.

rows.name: 488. Ghost Killer
rows.text: All this figure's melee combat attacks count as magic attacks, additionally, it is Immune to Energy Drain.

rows.name: 489. Explosion Hardened
rows.text: Any attack that affects an area, instead of an individual target, does half damage, rounded down, against this figure.

rows.name: 490. Steel Heart
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +3 to a Will Roll. It may use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 491. Barbed Serpent Tale
rows.text: This figure has a serpent tail instead of legs. The tail features barbs or spikes near its end. The figure suffers -1 Move but never suffers movement penalties for going over rough ground. Also, it is always treated as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 492. Careless with Weapons
rows.text: This figure often breaks its own weapons. Whenever it rolls a natural "1 - 2" on an attack, the weapon it is using is broken and becomes useless. If the weapon is magical, it does not break, but it loses all bonuses and does not count as magical for the remainder of the game (except it still won't break due to this ability).

rows.name: 493. Three-Brawny Arms
rows.text: This figure has three arms or arm-like appendages, that are all stronger than normal. It may use a two-handed weapon or staff at the same time as a shield. This figure does +1 damage in melee combat.

rows.name: 494. Thamaturgic Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Will to resist or break free from spells from the Thaumaturgy school.

rows.name: 495. Poisonous Bite
rows.text: This figure has sharp fangs that secrete poison. Whenever this figure makes an attack, it may choose to bite instead of its normal attack. This has no Fight penalty, does -2 damage, and is poisonous.

rows.name: 496. Extremely Long Legs
rows.text: This figure has very long legs that grant it +2 Move.

rows.name: 497. Aardvark Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of an aardvark, and it gains the Burrowing trait.

rows.name: 498. Improved Brace
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may increase its Armour by 5 for the duration of one attack, but the decision to use this ability must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 499. No Knees
rows.text: This figure has normal-length legs, but no knees, making it awkward to walk. It suffers -1 Move and -3 to all Move Stat Rolls.

rows.name: 500. Electrically Powered
rows.text: This figure has electricity running through its veins. Any figure that causes damage to this figure in melee combat immediately suffers a +1 elemental magic attack (increase to +2 if it is wearing heavy armour).

rows.name: 501. Web Spinner
rows.text: Twice per game, this figure may spend an action to create a web. This web can be up to 6" long, must be anchored at both ends on terrain and some portion of the web must be adjacent to the figure. The web does not block line of sight; however, no figure may move through or climb over a web. The web can be destroyed by a melee attack, or a shooting attack that covers an area. Treat the web as having Fight +0, Armour 14, Health 1. Unless destroyed, the web remains until the end of the game.

rows.name: 502. Wraith Call
rows.text: This figure may spend an action, which can replace a move action, to scream. Roll a die. On an 18+ place a wraith at a random point along the table edge. On any other result, nothing happens, and the action is lost.

rows.name: 503. Empowered Strike
rows.text: If this figure forgoes all its actions for one activation (during an activation when it would receive at least 1), then the next time it hits an opponent in melee combat, the strike does an additional +6 elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 504. Moves on Four Limbs
rows.text: This figure uses all four limbs to move. This increases its speed but makes it more difficult to fight. It gains +1 Move but -1 Fight.

rows.name: 505. Demon Commander
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to target any uncontrolled demon within line of sight. That demon must make a Will Roll (TN20). If it fails, the figure may move the demon up to its Move stat in inches in any direction, including out of or into combat, so long as this move does not result in the demon taking immediate damage (such as walking off a cliff).

rows.name: 506. Werefrog
rows.text: This figure is half-man, half-frog. It suffers -1 Fight and -2 Health but gains the Amphibious trait and can jump up to its full movement without the need for a run up.

rows.name: 507. Limited Levitation
rows.text: Any time this figure activates, it may spend an action to gain the Levitation ability for the rest of the turn. This can replace a move action.

rows.name: 508. Perceptive Cyclops
rows.text: The figure suffers the same penalties as for the Lost Eye permanent injury but gains the True Sight trait.

rows.name: 509. Rabbit Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a rabbit. Due to its large ears, the figure gains the True Sight trait with a range of 6".

rows.name: 510. Metal Exoskeleton
rows.text: The figure has a tough exoskeleton, but no inner skeleton. It gains +4 Armour but -5 Health. The figure may not wear any form of armour.

rows.name: 511. Rat Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled giant rat. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 512. Blinding Aura
rows.text: Any figure that activates within 3" of this figure must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be blinded for the rest of the turn. While blinded, the figure's Move is reduced to 1, its Fight is reduced to +0 and it may not make any shooting attacks or take any action that requires line of sight. This ability does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 513. Half Life
rows.text: This figure exists in a strange form somewhere between life and death. This figure can choose whether or not it possesses the Undead trait at any given moment.

rows.name: 514. Attempted Self-Possession
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to invite a demon into its own body. Roll a die, on a 1 - 10 nothing happens, and the action is lost. On an 11 - 20, treat the figure as though it is under the effect of a Possess spell. This ability cannot be used if the figure is already possessed.

rows.name: 515. Extremely High Metabolism
rows.text: This figure burns calories extremely quickly and thus tends to run out of energy. This figure always counts as Wounded after the fourth turn of the game.

rows.name: 516. Strong Magic Resistance
rows.text: This figure gains +3 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 517. Glowing Blood
rows.text: This figure always counts as though a Glow Spell is active on it. It also gains +2 Health.

rows.name: 518. Laser Eyes
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to make a +2 elemental magic shooting attack doing +2 damage at a range of 12".

rows.name: 519. Large Antennae
rows.text: This figure has large antennae which help it perceive the world. It gains +3 Will.

rows.name: 520. Two Extra Hands
rows.text: The figure has a pair of extra hands somewhere on its body. The figure gains two additional item slots.

rows.name: 521. Killer's Enchantment
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, then its attacks all count as magical for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 522. Large Tusks
rows.text: This figure always counts as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 523. Spellcaster Allergy
rows.text: This figure suffers extremely allergic reactions to spellcasters. Whenever it is in combat with a spellcaster, it suffers -2 Fight.

rows.name: 524. Extremely Slippery
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to force combat with this figure must first pass a Move Roll (TN20). If the roll is failed, the figure may not force combat, but may attempt to do so against another figure later in the turn.

rows.name: 525. Static Discharge
rows.text: Whenever this figure completes a Move action, the nearest other figure in line of sight and within 8" suffers a -1 elemental shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 526. Thick Blubber
rows.text: This figure has a thick blubbery layer all around its body. It gains +2 Health and is immune to any scenario effects caused by cold (though not attacks).

rows.name: 527. Enchanted Bones
rows.text: This figure's bones are enchanted with powerful magic. All its attacks count as magic attacks, and it gains +2 on Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 528. Soul-Linked
rows.text: Select one other random member of the warband. This figure is soul-bonded to it and gains +3 Health. If that figure is reduced to 0 Health, then this figure is also immediately reduced to 0 Health. The reverse is not true. If the bonded figure leaves the warband for any reason a new random warband member must be selected to be bonded.

rows.name: 529. Fox Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a fox and gains +3 Will.

rows.name: 530. Powerful Favour
rows.text: This figure is owed a favour by some powerful entity. This figure may add +5 to any one roll it makes on the Survival Table. After it has done this, the powerful favour is lost. A figure may choose to use this ability after the Survival Roll has been made.

rows.name: 531. Toxic Belch
rows.text: This figure has toxic glands in its throat that allow it to belch a poisonous fog. This figure may spend an action to belch at any figure within 4". That figure must make a Will Roll (TN14) or be poisoned.

rows.name: 532. Gigantic Ears
rows.text: The figure has gigantic ears which improve its hearing. The figure gains True Sight with a range of 6".

rows.name: 533. Enchantment Purge
rows.text: At the end of every turn, roll a die for this figure. On a 6+ all spells currently active on the figure are cancelled.

rows.name: 534. Alligator Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of an alligator. It always counts as armed with a hand weapon due to its bite attack.

rows.name: 535. Magic Allergy
rows.text: Whenever this figure is hit by a magic attack, it suffers -5 Armour against that attack.

rows.name: 536. Powerful Undead
rows.text: The figure gains the Undead trait and does +1 damage on melee attacks.

rows.name: 537. Flaming Bile
rows.text: This figure can vomit flaming bile. It may make magic shooting attacks with a 3" range and +0 damage.

rows.name: 538. Body of Stone
rows.text: The figure's body is composed completely of stone. Its Armour stat is increased by 3, but it may no longer wear armour of any type. Additionally, it suffers -3 to all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 539. Insect Companions
rows.text: This figure is constantly surrounded by a cloud of friendly flying insects. All other figures within 2" of this figure suffer -1 to all rolls.

rows.name: 540. Heron Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a heron. It always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 541. Quick Step
rows.text: Once per game, when this figure activates, it may move 2" in any direction, regardless of whether it is in combat. No figure may force combat as a result of this move.

rows.name: 542. Bonehead
rows.text: This figure has bone ridges in its head, which makes it tougher and allows it to headbutt opponents. It gains +1 Health and does not suffer the -2 damage for being unarmed.

rows.name: 543. Jinx
rows.text: If this figure is part of a warband, the first Survival Roll made by a member of the group after each game is at -1. (The player may always choose the order to make Survival Rolls).

rows.name: 544. Improved Power Lifter
rows.text: This figure never suffers any encumbrance or movement penalty for carrying treasure tokens. It may also carry two treasure tokens at the same time.

rows.name: 545. Nearly Blind
rows.text: This figure has a maximum line of sight of 6".

rows.name: 546. Spikey Armoured Shell
rows.text: This figure has a shell covering a large part of its body. This figure cannot wear any armour but gains +2 Armour. Additionally, this figure always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 547. Improved Lunging Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may force combat with a figure that moves within 3" of it, instead of the normal 1".

rows.name: 548. Killer's Sight
rows.text: If this figure reduces another figure to 0 Health, it gains the True Sight trait for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 549. Extremely Painful Body Restructure
rows.text: At the start of each turn, this figure may spend 2 Health and choose one of the following traits: Amphibious, Expert Climber, Immune to Poison, or Never Wounded. This figure has this trait until its next activation.

rows.name: 550. Weregorilla
rows.text: The figure is half-man, half-gorilla. It gains +1 Fight, +2 Health and the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 551. Three Heads
rows.text: This figure has three heads, which makes it nearly impossible to gang up against. Figures fighting this creature always count as having one less supporting figure than they actually do (to a minimum of 0), and supporting figures only provide a +1 support bonus.

rows.name: 552. Enhanced Project Self
rows.text: This figure can spend a move action and immediately move 8" in any direction, so long as the final spot is in line of sight. This can move this figure into or out of combat. The figure may now use any other actions it has. However, as soon as this figure has completed this activation, move it back to the point where it activated.

rows.name: 553. Deadeye
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a natural "18 or 19" on a Shooting Roll, it may convert this roll to a "20" and a critical hit.

rows.name: 554. Horrific Death Scream
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, all figures within 6" immediately suffer a +1 attack.

rows.name: 555. Hardened Elemental Armour
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (5).

rows.name: 556. Nearly 2-Dimensional
rows.text: This figure is so thin in one dimension as to be almost flat. It suffers -2 Armour but can fit through any gap, no matter how narrow.

rows.name: 557. Massive Blood Evaporation
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, its blood evaporates into a misty pink cloud. Place a 3" diameter cloud centred on the figure. This cloud blocks all line of sight, but not movement. At the end of each turn, roll a die. On a 1 - 5 the cloud disperses.

rows.name: 558. Extreme Mitigation
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can reduce the damage from any one source by 8.

rows.name: 559. Minor Demon-Spawn
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place a minor demon on the spot where the figure fell.

rows.name: 560. Perceptive Troglodyte
rows.text: This figure is used to living where invisible things creep. The figure gains the True Sight trait. It never suffers any reduction in the maximum line of sight due to darkness. If outside, on land, and in the daylight, however, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 561. Vulture Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a vulture. Its sharp beak means it is always counted as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 562. Viper Arms
rows.text: This figure has snakes for arms. It may not carry any weapons or shields of any type. However, it always counts as armed with a poisonous hand weapon with +1 Fight.

rows.name: 563. Eagle Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of an eagle. It gains +1 Shoot.

rows.name: 564. Powerful Brachiator
rows.text: This figure can hurl itself about by its arms. It gains the Expert Climber trait and can jump up to its full movement from a standing position if next to a vertical terrain piece.

rows.name: 565. Half-Demonic
rows.text: This figure can choose whether or not it possesses the Demon trait at any given moment and may switch between having or not having it merely by declaring it so. While it does have the Demon trait, it also gains Elemental Resistance (3).

rows.name: 566. Long Whiskers
rows.text: This figure has long whiskers allowing it to sense things close by that it cannot see. It gains True Sight with a range of 5".

rows.name: 567. Advanced Mind Cloud
rows.text: Once per game, a figure may use this ability as a free action. For the remainder of the turn, no figure may force combat with it.

rows.name: 568. Octopus Head
rows.text: This figure's head looks like an octopus, tentacles and all. This figure gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 569. Amorphous
rows.text: This figure has no solid bone structure and can reorganize its body mass at will. This allows it to move through any opening no matter how small.

rows.name: 570. Hibernate
rows.text: Roll a die before each game; on a "1", this figure is hibernating and must miss the game. It may remain a part of the warband and be replaced by a free figure for this game. The next time this figure participates in a game, it starts the game at +2 Health.

rows.name: 571. Potent Acidic Blood
rows.text: If this figure is damaged in melee combat, all other figures in the combat immediately suffer 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 572. Withered Half
rows.text: One half of this figure's body has withered away so that it is almost useless. Treat the figure has though it has both the Crushed Arm and Smashed Leg permanent injuries.

rows.name: 573. Minor Static Charge
rows.text: If this figure makes a move action in which it moves at least 3" then the next time it hits with a melee combat attack, it does an additional 1 point of elemental magic damage. The actions do not have to be consecutive. This ability can be used any number of times during a game.

rows.name: 574. Valuable Trophy
rows.text: This figure has some valuable mutation. It gains the Bounty (50gc) trait.

rows.name: 575. Burning Soul
rows.text: All this figure's melee attacks count as magic attacks and do +1 damage. However, any time this figure rolls a natural "20" for any roll, it immediately suffers 2 points of damage.

rows.name: 576. Cute and Fluffy
rows.text: This figure is cute and unthreatening. Uncontrolled creatures will never move towards this figure if there is another target in line of sight. If in multiple combat, uncontrolled creatures will always target figures other than this one.

rows.name: 577. General of the Dead
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to cast Raise Zombie. The spell is automatically successful but produces a ghoul instead of a zombie.

rows.name: 578. Thin Ablative Skin
rows.text: This figure has a tough skin that it sheds and regrows. The figure gains +2 Health; however, the first 2 points of damage the figure takes during a game cannot be healed by any means in game - they only return for the next game.

rows.name: 579. Mind Slam
rows.text: Whenever this figure makes an attack in melee combat, it may force both figures in the combat to use their Will stat instead of their Fight stat for their Combat Roll. If this option is selected, this figure gains +2 to its own Fight Roll. Otherwise, the combat follows the normal rules.

rows.name: 580. Magic-Resistant Snail Shell
rows.text: This figure has a large snail shell on its back. This figure receives +2 Armour but may not wear any armour. At the start of a turn, the figure can "retreat into its shell". Until the start of its next activation, it gains +3 Armour (above the +2 it normally receives) and -3 Fight, and its Move is reduced to 2. This figure also receives +2 on all Will Rolls to resist or break spells, or +4 if it has retreated into its shell.

rows.name: 581. Extremely Warty
rows.text: This figure is covered in warts, which makes it slightly tougher, but also makes wearing armour extremely painful. The figure gains +1 Health but may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 582. Sprout Wings
rows.text: This figure may spend an action (which can replace a move action) and take 1 point of damage to gain the Flying trait for the remainder of this turn and all the next.

rows.name: 583. Long Arms, No Legs
rows.text: This figure has no legs, but long, muscular arms. It suffers -1 Move, but it does +1 damage in melee combat.

rows.name: 584. Plague Carrier
rows.text: This figure carries a horrific disease. It suffers a permanent -4 Health. Any figure that is wounded by this figure in melee combat must make an immediate Health Roll (TN20). If it fails, it contracts a mild form of the disease and starts the next game at -5 Health (cumulative with any other penalties).

rows.name: 585. Colourful Neck Frill
rows.text: This figure possesses a large, colourful frill that expands out from its neck. This makes the figure a confusing target. Anyone targeting this figure with a shooting attack suffers a -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 586. Construct Commander
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to target any uncontrolled construct within line of sight. That construct must make a Will Roll (TN20). If it fails, the figure may move the construct up to its Move stat in inches in any direction, including out of or into combat, so long as this move does not result in the construct taking immediate damage (such as walking off a cliff).

rows.name: 587. Blade Hands
rows.text: This figure has no hands, just blades. The figure cannot carry any weapons or shields. However, it gains +1 Fight and always counts as armed with a magic hand weapon.

rows.name: 588. Major Regeneration
rows.text: This figure gains back up to 2 points of lost Health every time it activates.

rows.name: 589. Mind-Robber
rows.text: If this figure damages another figure in melee combat, the damaged figure must make a Will Roll (TN14). If it fails, it becomes a temporary member of this figure's warband. It may make another Will Roll to break this control at the end of each of its activations.

rows.name: 590. Cobra Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a cobra. It always counts as armed with a poisoned dagger.

rows.name: 591. Weak but Very Fast
rows.text: This figure has +1 Move and +3 Fight but does half damage (rounded up) in melee combat.

rows.name: 592. Short Range Telepathy
rows.text: This figure can always group activate with one other model, provided that model is within 12" and has not previously activated in the turn. (Apprentices still may not activate in the Wizard Phase).

rows.name: 593. Highly Explosive Sneeze
rows.text: This figure has highly volatile sneezes. If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" on an Initiative Roll, this figure sneezes, and all other figures within 2" immediately suffer a +2 shooting attack. This does not apply to the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 594. Enhanced Crumbling Touch
rows.text: Three times per game, this figure may spend an action to successfully cast the Crumble Spell against a terrain feature within 1".

rows.name: 595. Enchanted Horns
rows.text: This figure has a set of magical horns. It gains the Horns trait. Whenever it makes an attack where it receives the bonus for using horns, this attack counts as a magic attack.

rows.name: 596. Explosive Excrement
rows.text: This figure excretes an explosive substance. If this figure forgoes all its actions in an activation, during an activation where it has at least one action, it may place a marker on the table adjacent to it. If any other creature moves within 1" of this marker, it explodes, and all figures within 3" suffer a +5 magic shooting attack. This figure may never have more than two such markers on the table at one time. This figure is immune to attacks from its own excrement, nor does it ever trigger them.

rows.name: 597. Distracting Laugh
rows.text: This figure's constant laughter is extremely distracting. Figures suffer -1 to all rolls while within 2" of this figure. This does not apply on the first turn of a game.

rows.name: 598. Extremely Extendable Arms
rows.text: This figure may pick up a treasure token within 5" provided there is no enemy figure within 1" of either the figure or the token.

rows.name: 599. Sticky Leg Tentacles
rows.text: The figure's legs are replaced with a mass of tentacles. This figure has -1 Move, but never suffers movement penalties for movement over rough ground or climbing.

rows.name: 600. Limited Teleportation
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to teleport anywhere within 6" and line of sight. This action can replace a move action and can be done while in combat.

rows.name: 601. Covered in Quills
rows.text: Most of this figure's body is covered in quills or spines. It cannot wear any type of Armour. Whenever a figure in melee combat with this figure rolls a natural "1 - 5" on its Combat Roll, it suffers 2 points of damage in addition to whatever damage it takes if it loses the combat.

rows.name: 602. Pig Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a pig and suffers -1 Will.

rows.name: 603. Blazing Form
rows.text: Any opposing figure that wants to make a shooting attack of any type against this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, it is blinded for the remainder of the turn, and its stats are reduced to Move 1, Fight +0, Shoot +0.

rows.name: 604. Unihorn
rows.text: This figure has one large horn in the middle of its head. It gains the Horns trait.

rows.name: 605. Fated for Mediocrity
rows.text: This figure rolls 3d6 instead of d20 for all its die rolls. In this case, treat 18 as a critical hit/automatic success and 3 as an automatic failure.

rows.name: 606. Freezing Grasp
rows.text: This figure does +3 damage in melee combat. This bonus does not apply against undead or constructs.

rows.name: 607. Static Charge
rows.text: If this figure makes a move action in which it moves at least 3", then the next time it hits with a melee combat attack, it does an additional 2 points of elemental magic damage. The actions do not have to be consecutive. This ability can be used any number of times during a game.

rows.name: 608. Devastating Blow
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure inflicts damage in melee combat, it may use this ability to inflict an extra 4 points of damage.

rows.name: 609. Exploding Poisonous Pustules
rows.text: This figure is covered in poisonous pustules that regularly pop open in a spray of poisonous fluid. Any figure that fights in a round of combat with this figure, must make a Will Roll (TN14) or be poisoned, regardless of the outcome of the fight.

rows.name: 610. Sonic Digger
rows.text: This figure can use its vocal cords to generate a sonic wave capable of digging through the hardest earth. The figure gains the Burrowing trait.

rows.name: 611. Strong Magic Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure suffers -3 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 612. Double Jointed
rows.text: This figure can bend in all kinds of strange ways. It gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 613. Stubby Legs
rows.text: This figure has almost no legs at all. Its body seems to go straight from thighs to feet. It suffers -2 Move.

rows.name: 614. Major Addiction
rows.text: This figure is addicted to some substance and must spend 40gc before each game or suffer -2 Health and -1 to all die rolls during the game due to withdrawal.

rows.name: 615. Horrific Appearance
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to move into combat with this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN12). If it fails, the action is lost, though the figure may continue with its activation if it has other actions.

rows.name: 616. Painful Laughter
rows.text: Whenever this figure is activated, it releases a painfully high-pitched laugh. All living figures (not undead or constructs) within 2" must make a Will Roll (TN8) taking damage equal to the amount by which it failed the roll. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 617. Hands of Death
rows.text: This figure has skeletal hands. All its melee attacks count as magic attacks and do +2 damage against living creatures (so not undead or constructs).

rows.name: 618. Low Boiling Point
rows.text: This figure's blood starts to boil at much lower than usual temperatures, making it vulnerable to heat and elemental magic attacks. This figure suffers double damage from elemental attacks including all forms of fire.

rows.name: 619. Mana Battery (2/2)
rows.text: This figure produces mystical energy that can be tapped by friends who know how. If a figure in the same warband attempts to cast a spell within 3" of this figure, it may draw upon this figure to add +2 to the roll. This can be done twice each game.

rows.name: 620. Hoofed Legs
rows.text: This figure has hooves instead of feet. It gains +1 Move but suffers -3 on Move Stat Rolls.

rows.name: 621. Murderous Strike
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a "17 - 19" on a melee combat attack, it may convert this roll to a "20" and thus a critical hit.

rows.name: 622. Demon Attracter
rows.text: If this figure is on the table when the controlling player rolls a natural "1 - 3" for its Initiative Roll, place an imp on the table at a random point along the table edge.

rows.name: 623. Frequent Insanity
rows.text: If this figure ever rolls a natural "1 - 3" on any roll during the game, it goes temporarily insane and counts as an uncontrolled creature. This lasts for the rest of the turn on which the "1 - 3" was rolled and all the next turn. After that, the insanity passes, and the figure returns to its normal allegiance.

rows.name: 624. Regenerating Organs
rows.text: This figure's organs heal almost instantly. It gains the Immune to Critical Hits trait.

rows.name: 625. Death Eye
rows.text: This figure has a third eye which can command death. Once per game, you can spend an action to automatically cast the Strike Dead Spell with a Casting Roll of 15. As per the spell, you take 1 damage using this ability.

rows.name: 626. Deathwish
rows.text: This figure doesn't care if it lives or dies. It never gains any bonuses from being in cover and suffers -2 to all Fight Rolls against shooting attacks, but it automatically passes all Will Rolls to resist the effects of Fear or Horror.

rows.name: 627. Powerful Ink Spray
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spray ink at an opponent. Treat the figure as though it cast a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 16. The effects of this cannot be cancelled by effects that cancel magic.

rows.name: 628. Runic Arms
rows.text: This figure has runes branded, tattooed, or carved into its arms. All its attacks count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 629. Spider Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled ice spider. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 630. Burrowing Troglodyte
rows.text: This figure is used to living underground and digging tunnels. Its eyes have adapted to the dark. The figure gains the Burrowing trait. It never suffers any reduction in the maximum line of sight due to darkness. If outside, on land, and in the daylight, however, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 631. Spider Blood
rows.text: This figure has the blood of spiders flowing in its veins. It gains the Immune to Poison trait.

rows.name: 632. Extremely Squishy
rows.text: This figure is extremely soft. It suffers -3 Armour.

rows.name: 633. Improved Phosphorescent Spray
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to spray a phosphorescent film at an opponent within 6" and line of sight. The spray affects all figures that are either in contact or in combat with the target figure. The target and all other affected figures must make a Move Roll (TN20). If a figure fails, it is covered with the film and all shooting rolls against it are at +3 for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 634. Boiling Blood Spew
rows.text: This figure has boiling hot blood that it can spew at opponents. This figure may spend an action to make a +3 shooting attack with +2 damage at a range of 10" against all figures within 0.5" of a chosen point. However, the sprayer immediately takes 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 635. Super Bulky
rows.text: This figure has grown very large. It gains +3 Health and the Large trait.

rows.name: 636. Wraith-Reanimation
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place an uncontrolled wraith at the point it fell.

rows.name: 637. Third Eye
rows.text: This figure has a third eye somewhere on its face. It also gains the Mind Lock trait.

rows.name: 638. Major Static Discharge
rows.text: Whenever this figure completes a Move action, the nearest other figure in line of sight suffers a +0 elemental shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 639. Extremely Loud Soul
rows.text: If any player rolls to check for a Random Encounter after picking up a treasure token while this figure is on the table, roll two dice and keep both results.

rows.name: 640. Poisonous Detachable Spines
rows.text: This figure has long, poisonous spines growing from its body which it can detach and even throw. This figure always counts as armed with a poison dagger and has a 6" shooting attack doing -1 damage and poison.

rows.name: 641. More Plant than Man
rows.text: This figure's internal structure works more like a plant than an animal. It gains the Never Wounded trait.

rows.name: 642. Moose Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a moose and gains the Horns trait.

rows.name: 643. Inhumanly Obese
rows.text: This figure is so fat that it is hard to recognize what kind of creature it actually is as it is has become mostly blob-like. It suffers -3 Move (to a minimum of 1) but gains +5 Health.

rows.name: 644. Poisonous Blood
rows.text: If this figure is below its starting Health, all its attacks count as poisonous. This figure may spend an action to do 1 point of damage to itself.

rows.name: 645. Big and Strong
rows.text: This figure gains the Large and Strong traits.

rows.name: 646. Magically-Attuned Cyclops
rows.text: This figure can see the ways of magic through its one eye. The figure suffers the same penalties as for the Lost Eye permanent injury. If this figure is a spellcaster, it may claim a +5 on one Casting Roll, once per game. This decision must be made before the dice are rolled. If the figure is not a spellcaster, it gains +5 on one Will Roll to resist or overcome a spell, once per game, but may make the decision to use this ability after the die is rolled.

rows.name: 647. Blind
rows.text: This figure is blind but uses other senses to make up for it. It gains the True Sight trait, and never suffers any penalties from receiving the Lost Eye permanent injury. It is also Immune to the Blinding Light spell.

rows.name: 648. Blood-Marked
rows.text: This figure has strange red symbols all over its body. It gains +5 on all Will Rolls to resist Mind Control or Suggestion. Should a creature with blood-marked become unarmed, it suffers the usual -2 Fight, but not the -2 damage.

rows.name: 649. Visions of Doom
rows.text: This figure is cursed with visions of its own doom. If the player ever rolls a natural "18 - 20" for initiative, this figure receives a maximum of one action in its next activation.

rows.name: 650. Magical Self-Projectile
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to make a magic shooting attack at a target up to 6" away. This attack does +3 damage. After the attack, move the shooting figure 1.5" away from the target in a random direction, and the shooting figure takes 3 points of damage. If the shooting figure is carrying a treasure token, it drops it at the point it made the shooting attack.

rows.name: 651. Highly Empathetic
rows.text: Whenever another figure within 6" rolls a natural "20" on any roll, this figure gains back 2 lost points of Health. However, if a figure within 6" is reduced to 0 Health, this figure immediately suffers 4 points of damage.

rows.name: 652. Shining Butterfly Wings
rows.text: This figure has large, fragile wings. It gains the Flying trait but loses this ability as soon as it falls below its starting Health. Additionally, the figure gains +2 Will.

rows.name: 653. Clumsy
rows.text: This figure suffers -4 to all Move Rolls.

rows.name: 654. Walrus Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of walrus and gains the Horns trait, to represent its tusks.

rows.name: 655. Redundant Organs
rows.text: This figure has multiple, redundant organs. It gains the Immune to Critical Hits trait.

rows.name: 656. Poison Rage
rows.text: If this figure is ever poisoned, it gains +2 Fight and +2 damage on all melee combat attacks.

rows.name: 657. Resistant to Missile Weapons
rows.text: This figure never takes more than 2 points of damage from non-magic bow, crossbow, or javelin attacks. It takes full damage from all other shooting attacks, including attacks made with magic arrows, bolts, or javelins.

rows.name: 658. Extremely Long Neck
rows.text: This figure has an extremely elongated neck, which unfortunately makes it vulnerable. It suffers +7 damage (instead of the normal +5) any time it suffers a critical hit.

rows.name: 659. Suicide Attack
rows.text: This figure does +8 damage on melee attacks. However, if it inflicts any damage in melee it is immediately reduced to 0 Health.

rows.name: 660. Whipping Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has tentacles that whip around its body. Any time any figure (including friendly ones) moves or activates within 3" of this figure, it suffers a +2 shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 661. Chilling Touch
rows.text: This figure does +2 damage in melee, except against undead and constructs.

rows.name: 662. Demon Hunter's Will
rows.text: This figure gains +2 on all Will Rolls if there are non-allied demons on the table.

rows.name: 663. Powerful Ink Spew
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spray ink in all directions. Treat the figure as though it had just cast a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 16 against every other figure within 3". The effects of this cannot be cancelled by effects that cancel magic.

rows.name: 664. Bison Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a bison. It gains the Horns trait.

rows.name: 665. Channel Will
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it may declare that it is channelling its Will. All its melee attacks become magic attacks and do +1 damage; however, the figure suffers -3 Will Rolls until the start of its next activation.

rows.name: 666. Heavy Blubber
rows.text: This figure has a heavy blubbery layer all around its body. It gains +3 Health and is immune to any scenario effects resulting from the cold (but not cold attacks).

rows.name: 667. Limited Force Bubble
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to form a bubble of force around it that pushes all other figures away. All figures in line of sight suffer a +8 shooting attack, but instead of damage, they are moved a number of inches equal to the amount of damage they would have taken directly away from this figure. A figure will stop if it hits any terrain over 1" high but will move over shorter terrain or other figures.

rows.name: 668. Undead Hunter's Will
rows.text: This figure gains +2 to all Will Rolls if there are non-allied undead on the table.

rows.name: 669. Draining Tentacles
rows.text: This figure has numerous tentacles which it can use to grapple and entrap enemies and suck their blood. Whenever this figure does at least 1 point of damage in melee combat, it regains 1 point of lost Health. Additionally, no figure in combat with this one may push this figure back, or step back from combat, unless it deals damage; simply winning the combat is not enough.

rows.name: 670. Delicious Smell
rows.text: This figure smells tasty to animals. Any uncontrolled animal within 6" will target this figure over any others when making its moves (the figure doesn't have to be in line of sight). Additionally, animals will always attack this figure in preference to any other. If an animal reduces this figure to 0 Health, it suffers -1 on its Survival Roll due to the animal feasting.

rows.name: 671. Animal Hunter's Will
rows.text: This figure gains +2 to all Will Rolls if there are non-allied animals on the table.

rows.name: 672. Skull Enchanter
rows.text: This figure may opt to carry a skull, which counts as an item. Once per game, this figure may spend an action to animate that skull, as though it had cast the Animate Skull spell.

rows.name: 673. Werehippo
rows.text: This figure is half-man, half-hippopotamus. It gains +2 Health, does +1 damage, and gains the Large and Amphibious traits.

rows.name: 674. Fear of Demons
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 to all Will Rolls if there are any demons on the table.

rows.name: 675. Hurtling Attack
rows.text: This figure gains +6 Move on any move action that attempts to move the figure into combat.

rows.name: 676. Innate Undead Slayer
rows.text: Whenever the player controlling this figure rolls a natural "18 - 20" for their Initiative Roll, this figure may immediately cast Destroy Undead at a target of its choosing as a free action.

rows.name: 677. Chameleon Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a chameleon, which gives it great all-around vision. It receives +2 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 678. Fear of Undead
rows.text: This figure suffers -3 to Will Rolls if there are undead on the table.

rows.name: 679. Reliable
