rows.text: This figure rolls 2d10 instead of d20 for all die rolls during a game. In this case, treat any natural "2" as an automatic failure.

rows.name: 680. Two Animal Heads
rows.text: This figure has two heads, each from a different animal (the player may choose which). This makes it tougher to gang up on this figure. Figures only grant a +1 supporting figure bonus when fighting this figure.

rows.name: 681. Soulrattling Wail
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to wail. All figures within 8", including the active figure, must make a Will Roll (TN12) or suffer damage equal to the amount by which they failed the roll. Undead and constructs are immune to this damage, as are any figures that cannot hear.

rows.name: 682. Shadowy Form
rows.text: This figure is very dark and tough to distinguish from shadows. No figure may draw line of sight to this figure if it is more than 12" away. In addition, it gains +3 to all Fight Rolls made against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 683. Gigantic Hand
rows.text: This figure has one normal-sized hand and one gigantic hand. This figure does +1 damage in melee combat and always counts as armed with a hand weapon.

rows.name: 684. Adamant Heart
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +4 to a Will Roll. It may decide to use this ability after the die is rolled.

rows.name: 685. Fear of Animals
rows.text: This figure suffers -3 to Will Rolls if there are animals on the table.

rows.name: 686. Finger Darts
rows.text: This figure may fire the bones out of its fingers. This figure may spend an action to make a shooting attack that follows the rules for a successfully cast Bone Dart spell. The figure may do this a maximum of five times in the game. Once a figure has used this ability once in a game, it may no longer use a two-handed weapon, staff, bow, or crossbow. The figure's bones grow back between games.

rows.name: 687. Swallow and Regurgitate
rows.text: This figure can carry an extra item inside of it; however, it can't make use of it. It may spend an action to swallow one item and regurgitate another, thus switching which item it can use at a given time.

rows.name: 688. Painful Body Restructure
rows.text: When this figure activates, it may spend 1 Health and choose one of the following traits: Amphibious, Expert Climber, Immune to Poison, or Never Wounded. This figure has this trait until its next activation.

rows.name: 689. Doomed Shot Magnet
rows.text: This figure suffers -3 Fight whenever it rolls against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 690. Major Static Charge
rows.text: If this figure makes a move action in which it moves at least 3", then the next time it hits with a melee combat attack, it does an additional 3 points of elemental magic damage. The actions do not have to be consecutive. This ability can be used any number of times during a game.

rows.name: 691. Pumpkinhead
rows.text: This figure has a carved pumpkin for a head. It suffers -1 Armour, -2 Health, and gains the Magic Attacks, Mind Lock, and Undead traits.

rows.name: 692. Werewasp
rows.text: This figure is half-human, half-wasp. It suffers -1 Move, -1 Fight, -1 Armour and -2 Health, but gains the Flying and Poison traits.

rows.name: 693. Covered in Feathers
rows.text: This figure is covered in feathers. It cannot fly, but they do help slow its fall. This figure can fall any distance without taking damage.

rows.name: 694. Walking Head
rows.text: This figure is basically just a head with arms and legs. It suffers -1 Move.

rows.name: 695. Shattering Sneeze
rows.text: This figure has highly volatile sneezes. If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" on an Initiative Roll, this figure sneezes, and all other figures within 2" immediately suffer a +3 shooting attack. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 696. Hatred of Undead
rows.text: This figure must use all of its actions to move directly toward and attack the closest non-allied undead creature in line of sight, if there is a non-allied undead creature within 10" when this figure activates.

rows.name: 697. Scalding Blood Spew
rows.text: This figure has boiling hot blood that it can spray at opponents. This figure may spend an action to make a +4 shooting attack with +2 damage at a range of 10" against all figures within 0.5" of a chosen point. However, the sprayer takes 4 points of damage.

rows.name: 698. Rotting
rows.text: This figure is slowly rotting away. It gains +1 Armour, but it suffers a cumulative -1 Health after every game until it reaches 0 and dies.

rows.name: 699. Magical Venom Sacks
rows.text: This figure has enchanted venom sacks on the back of its arms. All its melee attacks count as Magic and Poison.

rows.name: 700. Four Arms/No Legs
rows.text: This figure has four arms, but no legs. It suffers -2 Move but gains the Expert Climber trait.

rows.name: 701. Demonic Oubliette
rows.text: Any time a demon moves into contact with this figure, or activates while in contact with this figure, it must make a Will Roll (TN16) or be imprisoned within the figure. This figure may only imprison one demon at a time, so if it already has one imprisoned, this rule does not apply. A figure may release a demon at any time by spending an action and must place that demon within 3". Alternatively, the demon can be released after the game in which case it runs off.

rows.name: 702. Mystic Absorber
rows.text: All figures within 3" of this figure suffer -1 to all Casting Rolls.

rows.name: 703. Thunderhand
rows.text: Whenever this figure pushes an opponent back after winning a round of combat, it may push the opponent back 1 - 6". Does not apply to creatures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 704. Focus Elemental Power
rows.text: If this figure forgoes all its actions during a single activation, during an activation where it has at least one action, it may charge its weapon as though Elemental Hammer had been cast upon it.

rows.name: 705. Amphibious Troglodyte
rows.text: This figure is used to living underground near water and its eyes have adapted to the dark. The figure gains the Amphibious trait. It never suffers any reduction in the maximum line of sight due to darkness. If outside, on land, and in the daylight, however, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Shoot.

rows.name: 706. Toad Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled Ice Toad. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 707. Hatred of Demons
rows.text: This figure must use all its actions to move directly toward and attack the closest non-allied demon, if there is a non-allied demon within 10" and line of sight when this figure activates.

rows.name: 708. Burning Blood
rows.text: If this figure is damaged in melee combat, all other figures in the combat immediately suffer 2 points of damage. Additionally, if the figure was damaged by a non-magical, melee combat weapon, that weapon is destroyed.

rows.name: 709. Lion Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a lion. It always counts as armed with a hand weapon thanks to its impressive bite.

rows.name: 710. Psychic Wings
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to make a Will Roll (TN15). If successful, the figure gains the Flying trait for either the next three turns or until the figure takes any damage. If the figure loses the Flying trait, it may attempt to regain it following the rules above.

rows.name: 711. Cool Hand
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +4 to one shooting attack, but the decision to use this ability must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 712. Cursed Touch
rows.text: Whenever this figure wins a round of melee combat against another figure, that figure is treated as though a Curse spell had just been cast against it with a Casting Roll of 14.

rows.name: 713. Undead Stench
rows.text: For some reason, undead recognize this figure as one of their own. Uncontrolled undead will never take this figure into account when determining their actions.

rows.name: 714. Blinding Flash
rows.text: This figure occasionally flashes with blinding light. Whenever a figure activates while in combat with this figure, it must immediately make a Will Roll (TN10) or suffer -5 Fight (to a minimum of +0) for the rest of its activation. Figures immune to Blinding Light are immune to this ability.

rows.name: 715. Hatred of Constructs
rows.text: This figure must use all of its actions to move directly toward and attack the closest non-allied construct, if there is a non-allied construct within 10" and line of sight when this figure activates.

rows.name: 716. Web Creator
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to create a web. This web can be up to 6" long, must be anchored at both ends on terrain and some portion of the web must be adjacent to the figure. The web does not block line of sight; however, no figure may move through, or climb over a web. The web can be destroyed by a melee attack, or a shooting attack that covers an area. Treat the web as having Fight +0, Armour 14, Health 1. Unless destroyed, the web remains until the end of the game.

rows.name: 717. Levitation
rows.text: This figure gains the Levitate trait.

rows.name: 718. Killer's Eye
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure rolls a natural "17 - 19" on a Shooting Roll, it may convert this roll to a "20" and a critical hit.

rows.name: 719. Demonic Aura
rows.text: For whatever reason, demons perceive this figure as one of their own. Uncontrolled demons will not take this figure into account when determining their actions.

rows.name: 720. Ball
rows.text: This figure is basically just a ball with arms. It rolls instead of walking. It gains +1 Move, and can jump normally, but cannot climb at all.

rows.name: 721. Devastating Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +5 to its Combat Roll in a melee combat that it initiates. This decision must be made before the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 722. Stinger
rows.text: This figure has a wasp-like stinger on its backside. It may make attacks with this stinger at its normal Fight, doing normal damage, plus the attack is poisonous.

rows.name: 723. Master of Stealth
rows.text: At the start of the game, after all figures, terrain and treasure have been placed, but before initiative on the first turn is rolled, this figure may be moved up to 12" in any direction, so long as it ends the move out of line of sight of any enemy figures, and is no closer than 3" to any treasure token. However, if it moves more than 3" it receives only one action the first time it activates, and this cannot be a move action.

rows.name: 724. Enchanted Razor Mandibles
rows.text: This figure has a large pair of mandibles near its mouth which it can use to attack. This figure always counts as armed with a magic hand weapon.

rows.name: 725. Jack o' Lantern Head
rows.text: This figure has a carved pumpkin for a head, with light glowing inside it. It suffers -1 Armour and -2 Health, but gains +2 Will as well as the Magic Attacks, Mind Lock, and Undead traits.

rows.name: 726. Magic Volatility
rows.text: Whenever this figure is hit by a magic attack, that attack does double damage. If this reduces the figure to 0 Health, then the figure explodes. All other figures within 3" suffer a +4 magic shooting attack, and this figure suffers -2 to its Survival Roll after the game.

rows.name: 727. Unstable Portal
rows.text: This figure is a portal to other realms. If you ever roll a natural "1" for your Initiative Roll while this figure is on the table, place an uncontrolled imp on the table 3d6" away from this figure in a random direction.

rows.name: 728. Ethereal Oubliette
rows.text: Any time an ethereal undead figure moves into contact with this figure, or activates while in contact with this figure, it must make a Will Roll (TN16) or be imprisoned within the figure. This figure may only imprison one ethereal undead at a time, so if it already has one imprisoned, this rule does not apply. A figure may release the ethereal undead at any time by spending an action and must place that creature within 3". Alternatively, the ethereal undead can be released after the game in which case it runs off.

rows.name: 729. Bat Form
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to turn in to a giant bat, gaining the Flying trait. All other stats remain unaffected, but the figure may not pick up or carry treasure tokens while in this form, and any treasure tokens it is carrying are dropped. The figure may use any items it has, and it still attacks in the same manner, using whatever weapons it normally carries.

rows.name: 730. Poison Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure has violent reactions to poison. Whenever it suffers damage from a poison attack, it immediately suffers an additional 5 points of damage.

rows.name: 731. Beast Master
rows.text: Once per turn, this figure may spend an action to summon any nearby beast. Immediately roll on the Random Encounter Table and place the creature at a random point on the table edge. It is an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 732. Unnatural Health
rows.text: This figure has no regular healing mechanism and can only be healed by consuming fresh blood from a sentient creature. It must either pay 5gc for enough blood to heal back to full Health or find some other way to obtain blood. It can take this blood from another warband member, but this figure is immediately removed from the roster and cannot be replaced until after the next game. It can also be healed by spells, but only during a game.

rows.name: 733. Elementally Charged
rows.text: This figure does +1 damage on all melee attacks, and all such attacks count as elemental magic attacks.

rows.name: 734. Extreme Growth with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it gains +1 Fight and +1 Damage for the rest of the game. This bonus can be gained three times in a scenario, with the effects stacking. If it gains this bonus twice, it also gains the Large trait for the remainder of the game.

rows.name: 735. Flashy Demise
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, treat every figure in line of sight of the last spot of the deceased as though struck with a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 14.

rows.name: 736. Acid Spray
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to spray acid out of its body. Treat this as a +5 elemental magic attack with a maximum range of 10". Additionally, this attack treats all targets as though they are Armour 10.

rows.name: 737. Hatred of Spellcasters
rows.text: This figure must use all of its actions to move directly toward and attack the closest non-allied spellcaster, if there is a non-allied spellcaster within 10" and line of sight when this figure activates.

rows.name: 738. Quarter Size
rows.text: This figure is only about ¼ the size of a normal person. It suffers -1 Move, -1 Fight, and -2 Health, but gains +4 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks.

rows.name: 739. Extreme Shrinking with Pain
rows.text: If this figure takes 5 or more points of damage from a single source, it suffers -1 Fight and -1 Damage for the rest of the game. This penalty can be suffered three times per game with the penalties stacking. If this penalty is suffered twice, the figure also gains +3 Fight when rolling against shooting attacks due to its small size.

rows.name: 740. Mind-Grabber
rows.text: If this figure damages another figure in melee combat, the damaged figure must make a Will Roll (TN14). If it fails, it becomes a temporary member of this figure's warband. It may make another Will Roll to break this control at the end of each of its activations. Figures with Mind Lock are immune to this ability.

rows.name: 741. Inferno Fists
rows.text: This figure can cause its fists to ignite in flames on command. This figure always counts as armed with a magical hand weapon that gives it +1 Fight and +3 elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 742. Invisible to Constructs
rows.text: This figure counts as invisible to all constructs. Additionally, uncontrolled constructs will never take this figure into account when determining their actions.

rows.name: 743. Treasure Addiction
rows.text: If this figure activates with an unclaimed treasure token within 10" and line of sight, it must use its actions to move towards it and pick it up. If there is an enemy figure within 6" and line of sight with a treasure token, it must use its actions to move toward it and attack if possible.

rows.name: 744. Mystical Force Projection
rows.text: This figure's attacks, of any type, count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 745. Crow Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a crow. It always counts as armed with a dagger and gains +2 Will.

rows.name: 746. Extreme Magic Resistance
rows.text: This figure gains +4 on all Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 747. Body of Metal
rows.text: The figure's body is made completely of metal. It gains +4 Armour but may no longer wear armour of any type. It suffers -5 to all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 748. Hatred of Animals
rows.text: This figure must use all its actions to move directly toward and attack the closest non-allied animal, if there is a non-allied animal within 10" and line of sight when this figure activates.

rows.name: 749. Extremely Acidic Blood
rows.text: If this figure is damaged in melee combat, all other figures in the combat immediately suffer 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 750. Thick Spikey Armoured Shell
rows.text: This figure has some sort of shell covering most of its body. This figure cannot wear any armour but gains +3 Armour and -1 Move. Additionally, this figure always counts as armed with a dagger.

rows.name: 751. Infectious
rows.text: Any figure wounded in melee combat by this figure will start the next game at -2 Health in addition to any other injuries sustained.

rows.name: 752. Giant Slayer
rows.text: This figure does +3 damage against figures with the Large trait.

rows.name: 753. Random Spellcaster
rows.text: Before each game, roll a random spell. This figure may attempt to cast that spell during the game at its base Casting Number. This figure counts as a spellcaster and may empower rolls.

rows.name: 754. Adrenaline Surge
rows.text: This figure gets charged up for a fight. It gains +2 to all die rolls it makes for the first three turns of the game. After that, it suffers -4 on all die rolls it makes for the remainder of the game.

rows.name: 755. Ethereal
rows.text: This figure gains the Ethereal trait but may never pick up any treasure or loot tokens.

rows.name: 756. Filtered Breathing
rows.text: This figure's lungs can filter out and expel any harmful gasses. This figure never takes damage or suffers any negative effects from breathing harmful substances.

rows.name: 757. Free Mover
rows.text: This figure is immune to the following spells: Blink, Bones of the Earth, Petrify, Push, Slow, and Transpose.

rows.name: 758. Giant Worm Attracter
rows.text: If this figure is on the table when the controlling player rolls a natural "1" on their Initiative Roll, place a giant worm on the table at a random point along the table edge.

rows.name: 759. Wounded Eagle
rows.text: If this figure is more than 4 points down from its starting Health, it grows wings and gains the Flying trait for the rest of the scenario.

rows.name: 760. Berserker Strength
rows.text: This figure does +3 damage in melee combat if it is below its starting Health.

rows.name: 761. Death Call
rows.text: This figure may spend an action, which can replace a move action, to scream. Roll a die. On a 16+ place a wraith at a random point along the table edge. On any other result, nothing happens, and the action is lost.

rows.name: 762. Extremely Brittle Bones
rows.text: This figure has a weak bone structure. It receives -3 to all Survival Rolls.

rows.name: 763. Murderous War Hound Companion
rows.text: This figure gains a war hound with a permanent +1 Fight and +1 Damage modifier as a companion. This dog counts as a member of the warband but does not take up a soldier slot. It may never intentionally move more than 6" away from its companion figure. If it activates more than 6" away, it must make a move directly towards its companion if possible. Note the reverse is not true and this figure can intentionally move more than 6" away from the hound. If the hound is killed, it is replaced before the next game.

rows.name: 764. Fast Slider
rows.text: This figure excretes a slippery liquid from its feet. If it moves in a completely straight line during a move action, it gains Move +2.

rows.name: 765. Rending Death Scream
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, all figures within 6" immediately suffer a +2 Attack. Figures that cannot hear are immune to this ability.

rows.name: 766. Massive Static Charge
rows.text: If this figure makes a move action in which it moves at least 3" then the next time it hits with a melee combat attack, it does an additional 4 points of elemental magic damage. The actions do not have to be consecutive. This ability can be used any number of times during a game.

rows.name: 767. Vengeful Skull
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place an animate skull at the spot where it fell. This is an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 768. Excretes Extremely Valuable Gems
rows.text: After every game in which this figure participates and survives, roll a die. On an 18+ it excretes a gem worth 100gc.

rows.name: 769. Frog Form
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to transform into a giant frog, gaining the Amphibious trait. All other stats remain unaffected, but the figure may not pick up or carry treasure while in this form and any treasure tokens it is carrying are dropped. The figure may use any items it has, and it still attacks in the same manner, using whatever weapons it normally carries. It may spend an action to switch back to its normal form.

rows.name: 770. Limited Elemental Blast
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to make a +8 elemental magic shooting attack with a maximum range of 3".

rows.name: 771. Treasure Hurler
rows.text: If this figure is carrying treasure, it may spend an action to hurl that treasure token up to 6" in any direction. The token suffers no damage. If the token is hurled at another figure, treat this as a +4 shooting attack.

rows.name: 772. Extremely Bouncy
rows.text: This figure suffers no damage from falling. In addition, when it falls, it may make a free move in any direction equal to the distance it fell.

rows.name: 773. Covered in Poisonous Quills
rows.text: Most of this figure's body is covered in quills or spines. It cannot wear any type of armour. Whenever a figure in melee combat with this figure rolls a natural "1 - 5" on its Combat Roll, it suffers 2 points of damage and is poisoned in addition to whatever damage it takes from losing the combat.

rows.name: 774. Ablative Skin
rows.text: This figure has a tough skin that it sheds and regrows. The figure gains +3 Health; however, the first three points of damage the figure takes during a game cannot be healed by any means in the game - they only return for the next game.

rows.name: 775. Powerful Enchanted Horns
rows.text: This figure has a set of magical horns. It gains the Horns trait. Whenever it makes an attack where it receives the bonus for using horns, this attack counts as a magic attack and does an additional 2 points of elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 776. Minor Ablative Elemental Resistance
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (5), but this decreases by 1 for every point of damage the Resistance prevents. This resets at the start of each game.

rows.name: 777. Extremely Valuable Trophy
rows.text: This figure has some valuable mutation. It gains the Bounty (100gc) trait.

rows.name: 778. Elemental Magnet
rows.text: Any Elemental Bolt or Elemental Ball spell cast with a target point within 4" of this figure has the target point moved to this figure.

rows.name: 779. Improved Dodge
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may increase its Armour by 4 for the duration of one combat round. It may use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 780. Teleport Blip
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to teleport d6" in a random direction. This ability may be used while in combat.

rows.name: 781. Minorly Empowered
rows.text: Every turn this figure gains 1 point of power. This can either be used to empower Casting Rolls or Will Rolls if the figure is a spellcaster or added to any damage the figure does in melee combat during the turn.

rows.name: 782. A Little Extra
rows.text: If this figure is ever in a melee combat that is tied, it receives +1 Fight, thus winning the combat. If both figures in the combat have this ability, they cancel each other out.

rows.name: 783. Wizard Killer
rows.text: This figure does double damage in melee combat against spellcasters.

rows.name: 784. Explosive Rune Tattoo
rows.text: This figure has a permanent explosive rune tattooed on its skin. Once per game, it can spend an action to trigger the rune. Follow the rules for an explosive rune, centred on this figure. This figure also suffers the +5 attack.

rows.name: 785. Uncontrollable Rage Projection
rows.text: Whenever the player that controls this figure rolls a natural "1 or 2" for their Initiative Roll, a Destructive Sphere spell is immediately cast centred on this figure. This figure is immune to the effects of this casting. This does not apply to the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 786. Radiant Aura
rows.text: Any figure that activates within 6" of this figure must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be blinded for the rest of the turn. While blinded, its Move is reduced to 1, its Fight is reduced to +0, and it may not make any shooting attacks or take any action that requires line of sight. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 787. Accursed Blow
rows.text: Whenever this figure wins a round of melee combat against another figure, that figure is treated as though a Curse spell had just been cast against it with a Casting Roll of 16.

rows.name: 788. Sensitive Antenna
rows.text: This figure has long antennae that can pick up subtle vibrations in the air. This figure gains True Sight with a range of 10".

rows.name: 789. Leaping Attack
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may force combat with a figure that moves within 4" of it, instead of the normal 1".

rows.name: 790. Limited Will
rows.text: This figure has +4 Will; however, every time it makes a Will Roll during a game, for any reason, it suffers a cumulative -1 Will for the rest of the game.

rows.name: 791. Assassin's Eye
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may add +2 to a shooting attack. It may decide to use this ability after the dice are rolled.

rows.name: 792. External Ribcage
rows.text: This figure gains +2 Armour and +1 Health but may not wear any armour.

rows.name: 793. Skull Animator
rows.text: This figure may opt to carry two skulls. These two skulls count as one item. This figure may spend an action to animate a skull, as though it had cast the Animate Skull spell. It may do this once for each skull carried.

rows.name: 794. Penetrating Stare
rows.text: This figure has eyes that project out of its eye sockets. This figure can draw line of sight through fog, clouds, and smoke, including those generated by spells or other magical effects.

rows.name: 795. Large Toxic Cloud Release
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to release a cloud of dark gas. Place a 4" diameter cloud adjacent to the figure. The figure suffers 2 points of damage every time it does this. Line of sight may not be drawn through the cloud. Any figure that moves through this cloud, apart from the figure that produced it, must make a Will Roll (TN12) or be poisoned. At the end of each turn, roll a die. On a 1 - 5 the cloud dissipates and is removed from the table.

rows.name: 796. Major Magic Immunity
rows.text: Whenever a spell is cast on this figure, or the effect of a spell would target this figure, roll a die. On an 8+ that spell has no effect on this figure.

rows.name: 797. Powerful Against Demons
rows.text: This figure does double damage in melee combat against demons.

rows.name: 798. Easy Healer
rows.text: If this figure is subject to any healing magic, it receives double the normal amount of healing. For example, a Heal spell restores up to 10 lost points of Health to this figure.

rows.name: 799. Penetrating Gaze
rows.text: This figure has completely yellow eyes. All its shooting attacks count as magic shooting attacks, and its target receives no benefit for wearing armour (so subtract 1 from its Armour stat for light armour and 2 if it is wearing heavy armour).

rows.name: 800. Soul Bargain
rows.text: The first time this figure rolls a "Dead" result on the Survival Table, it may treat the roll as "Full Recovery" instead, but it immediately gains the Demon trait.

rows.name: 801. Mystic Sinkhole
rows.text: All figures within 2" of this figure suffer -2 to all Casting Rolls.

rows.name: 802. Powerful Against Animals
rows.text: This figure does double damage in melee combat against animals.

rows.name: 803. Natural Spellcaster
rows.text: Before each game, roll two random spells. This figure may attempt to cast those spells during the game at its base Casting Number. This figure counts as a spellcaster and may empower rolls.

rows.name: 804. Resilient
rows.text: The figure gains +5 Health.

rows.name: 805. Lucky Charm
rows.text: If this figure is part of a warband, the first roll on the Survival Table made by a member of that group after each game is at +1. (Players may always choose the order in which Survival Rolls are made.)

rows.name: 806. Focused Mystic Shield
rows.text: If this figure forgoes all its actions during a single activation (during an activation where it was entitled to at least one action), it may summon a mystical shield. This shield follows the same rules as an Elemental Shield spell.

rows.name: 807. Unlife Feaster
rows.text: This figure feeds off the power of animate, non-living things. Whenever any undead or construct activates within 3", that figure immediately suffers 3 points of damage.

rows.name: 808. Extreme Magic Vulnerability
rows.text: This figure suffers -4 on Will Rolls to resist or overcome spells.

rows.name: 809. Burning Jack o' Lantern Head
rows.text: This figure has a carved pumpkin for a head, with light glowing inside it. It suffers -1 Armour and -2 Health, but gains +2 Will as well as the Magic Attacks, Mind Lock, and Undead traits. It also does +2 damage on all melee attacks.

rows.name: 810. Slippery
rows.text: Figures have an extremely hard time grappling or otherwise containing this figure. This figure may always move out of combat, and the figures that were previously in combat with it may not force combat with it until the end of its activation.

rows.name: 811. Power Word Tattoo
rows.text: This figure has a Power Word tattooed on its skin. Roll randomly to see which spell it goes with (roll again for Out of Game only spells). While this figure is on the table, it counts as though a Power Word for that spell is in effect.

rows.name: 812. Powerful Static Discharge
rows.text: Whenever this figure completes a move action, the nearest other figure in line of sight suffers a +1 elemental shooting attack.

rows.name: 813. Giant Worm Form
rows.text: Whenever this figure takes damage, it must make a Will Roll (TN10). If it fails, replace this model with an uncontrolled giant worm. After the game it returns to its regular form and allegiance.

rows.name: 814. Wasp Companions
rows.text: This figure is constantly surrounded by a cloud of wasps or other stinging or biting insects. All other figures within 2" of this figure suffer -2 to all rolls.

rows.name: 815. Peacock Feathers
rows.text: This figure has large peacock feathers which it can spread to distract the enemy. This figure provides a +3 supporting figure bonus in combat (instead of the normal +2).

rows.name: 816. Electrically Super-Charged
rows.text: This figure has electricity running through its veins. Any figure that causes damage to this figure in melee combat immediately suffers a +2 elemental magic attack (increase to +3 if it is wearing heavy armour).

rows.name: 817. Worm Transformation
rows.text: This figure can spend an action (which can replace a move action) to turn in to a giant worm, gaining the Burrowing and Large traits. All other stats remain unaffected, but the figure may not pick up or carry treasure while in this form and any treasure tokens it is carrying are dropped. The figure may use any items it has, and it still attacks in the same manner, using whatever weapons it normally carries. It may spend another action to return to its normal form.

rows.name: 818. Burning Death Eye
rows.text: This figure has a third eye which can command death. Once per game, you can spend an action to automatically cast the Strike Dead Spell with a Casting Roll of 18. As per the spell, the casting figure takes 1 point of damage using this ability.

rows.name: 819. Bladed Arms
rows.text: This figure has blades implanted in, or growing out of, its arms. This figure always counts as armed with a hand weapon, all its attacks count as magic attacks, and it does +1 damage. However, it may never use a shield.

rows.name: 820. Powerbash
rows.text: Whenever this figure pushes an opponent back after winning a round of combat, it may push the opponent back 1 - 10". Creatures with the Large trait may be pushed back a maximum of 5".

rows.name: 821. Mist Form
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to convert to mist form. While in mist form, the figure gains the Levitate trait and may move through any space, no matter how small. The figure may not pick up or carry treasure tokens and any treasure tokens it was holding are dropped. The figure may not cast spells or use any items, nor may it attack or make shooting attacks. The figure is immune to all non-magic weapons. Other figures may move into combat with the figure and attack; however, no figure may force combat against the mist form figure. If in combat, the mist form figure may move out of combat freely. The figure may spend an action to revert to its normal form.

rows.name: 822. Powerful Against Constructs
rows.text: This figure does double damage in melee combat against constructs.

rows.name: 823. Lord of the Dead
rows.text: Twice per game, this figure can spend an action to cast Raise Zombie. The spell is automatically successful and produces a ghoul instead of a zombie. This ghoul does not count against the warband limits. The figure may only have one ghoul in play at any time.

rows.name: 824. Detonating Excrement
rows.text: This figure excretes an explosive substance. If this figure forgoes all its actions in an activation, it may place a marker on the table. If any other figure moves within 3" of this marker, it explodes, and all figures within 3" suffer a +5 magic shooting attack. This figure may never have more than four such markers on the table at one time. This figure is immune to attacks from its own excrement and does not trigger them.

rows.name: 825. Mind Crush
rows.text: Whenever this figure makes an attack in melee combat, it may force both figures to use their Will stat instead of their Fight stat for the combat. If the option is selected, this figure gains +3 to its own Fight Roll. Otherwise, the combat follows the normal rules.

rows.name: 826. Monkey Form
rows.text: This figure can spend an action (which can replace a move action) to turn into a giant monkey, gaining the Expert Climber trait. All other stats remain unaffected, but the figure may not pick up or carry treasure tokens while in this form and any treasure tokens it is carrying are dropped. The figure may use any items it has, and it still attacks in the same manner, using whatever weapons it normally carries. The figure may spend another action to return to its normal form.

rows.name: 827. Serendipitous
rows.text: This creature is just incredibly lucky and receives +1 on all die rolls.

rows.name: 828. Spontaneous Combustion
rows.text: If this figure ever rolls a natural "1" on any roll, immediately roll again. If the second roll is a 1, this figure immediately detonates. It is reduced to 0 Health and suffers -4 to its Survival Roll after the game. Every figure within 6" and line of sight of the exploding figure suffers a +5 shooting attack.

rows.name: 829. Visionary
rows.text: This figure is blessed with visions of the future. If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "18 - 20" for initiative, this figure gains an extra action on its next activation.

rows.name: 830. Limited Mental Strike
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to make a mental attack against any enemy within 6" and line of sight. Fight a round of combat as normal, except both figures use their Will stat instead of their Fight Stat and neither figure can receive supporting figure bonuses. Both figures are counted as having Armour 10 for this combat. Damage is done as normal, but regardless of who wins, neither figure may step back or push back. These figures are not considered to be in combat.

rows.name: 831. Mind-Shattering Appearance
rows.text: Any figure that wishes to move into combat with this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN16). If it fails, its activation ends immediately.

rows.name: 832. Thick Ablative Skin
rows.text: This figure has a tough skin that it sheds and regrows. The figure gains +4 Health; however, the first 4 points of damage the figure takes during a game cannot be healed by any means in game - they only return for the next game.

rows.name: 833. Animator
rows.text: After any game in which this figure was not reduced to 0 Health, it can freely cast the Animate Construct spell once. This spell is automatically successful.

rows.name: 834. Weak Animated Skin
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to "shed its skin". This creates a second version of this figure that has the same stats, but only 1 Health. This second version counts as a soldier in the same warband as the original but may not cast spells or use any Tricks of the Trade. This figure has all the same equipment as the original, except none of it is magical (so replace magic weapons with mundane versions, while magic items, potions, etc are essentially worthless).

rows.name: 835. Concentration Storm
rows.text: It is difficult to concentrate when this figure is near. Any figure attempting to cast a spell suffers a -2 to the Casting Roll if this figure is within 6" and line of sight.

rows.name: 836. Child of the Storm
rows.text: Every time this figure suffers at least 1 point of damage, roll a die. On a 1 - 10 nothing happens. On an 11+ it automatically casts Call Storm with no roll or action necessary.

rows.name: 837. Blinding Demise
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, treat every figure in line of sight of the last spot of the deceased as though struck with a Blinding Light spell with a Casting Roll of 18.

rows.name: 838. Miracle Blessed
rows.text: Each game, after this figure makes any Survival Rolls it is required to, this figure may roll a die. On an 18+ it may heal one permanent injury on a figure in its warband, including itself. On a natural "20" it may bring a figure back from the dead that was killed in the proceeding game. This figure returns to full Health with no ill effects.

rows.name: 839. Greater Fog Form
rows.text: Twice per game, this figure may activate its fog form as a free action. For the rest of that activation and all of its next, it gains Move +4 and the Levitate trait, and no figure may force combat with it. Additionally, the figure is immune to all non-magic attacks. However, the figure may not attack any other figure or pick up treasure or loot. If the figure was carrying loot or treasure it is dropped at the point it activated the fog form.

rows.name: 840. Double Attack
rows.text: This figure may use one action to attack two figures that it is currently in combat with. Each Combat Roll is made separately and all support bonuses apply. This figure may decide the order of the attacks.

rows.name: 841. Uncontrolled Elemental Reflection
rows.text: If this figure is ever the target of an elemental shooting attack, roll a die. On a 1 - 10 nothing happens. On an 11+, randomly select another figure in line of sight of this figure as the new target of the attack.

rows.name: 842. Hardened Metal Exoskeleton
rows.text: The figure has a tough exoskeleton, but no inner skeleton. It gains +5 Armour but -7 Health. The figure may not wear any form of armour.

rows.name: 843. Poison Feeder
rows.text: This figure can suck poison out of a wound and use it to Heal itself. If this figure is ever within 1" of a friendly figure that is not in combat, it may spend an action (which can replace a Move action) to remove the poisoned condition from the friendly figure. The poison feeder gains back up to 3 lost Health each time it does this. Additionally, this figure is Immune to Poison and receives Armour +3 against any poison attack.

rows.name: 844. Greater Telekinetic Pull
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action and target a figure within 12" and line of sight. The target figure must make a Move Roll (TN25). If the target fails, it is immediately moved 3" directly towards the active figure. This may move a figure out of, or into, combat.

rows.name: 845. Draining Word Tattoo
rows.text: This figure has a Draining Word tattooed on its skin. Roll randomly to see which spell it goes with (roll again for Out of Game only spells). While this figure is on the table, a Draining Word for that spell is in effect.

rows.name: 846. Empowered Smash
rows.text: If this figure forgoes all its actions for one activation (on an activation where it is entitled to at least one action), then the next time it hits an opponent in melee combat, the strike does an additional +7 elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 847. Zombie Master
rows.text: If this figure kills another figure in melee combat, immediately place a zombie where that figure fell. This zombie counts as part of the same warband as the zombie master. The zombie master may only have one such zombie on the table at a time, so any further kills do not raise a new zombie. If the zombie master leaves the table for any reason, or the game ends, the zombie crumbles to dust.

rows.name: 848. Rat Master
rows.text: This figure always begins the game with a giant rat next to it. This rat counts as a member of the same warband but does not count against the normal warband size limits. If the Rat Master leaves the table for any reason, this giant rat immediately becomes an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 849. Powerful Against Undead
rows.text: This figure does double damage in melee combat against undead. Also, all its attacks against undead count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 850. Random Teleportation
rows.text: This figure may spend an action (which can replace a move action) to teleport d10" in a random direction. This ability can be used while in combat.

rows.name: 851. Time Tinkerer
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may spend an action to automatically cast Time Store. The figure must have at least two actions available and use this as its first action, thus saving the second for later in the game.

rows.name: 852. Enhanced Laser Eyes
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to make a +4 elemental magic shooting attack doing +2 damage at a range of 18".

rows.name: 853. Tumultuous Body Chemistry
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates and would normally have two actions, it can choose to roll a die. On a 1 - 15, it gains only one action this activation. On a 16+ it gains three.

rows.name: 854. Loud Buzz
rows.text: This figure gives off a loud buzzing noise whenever it moves. Any figure within 6" can "see" this figure, even if it is invisible. However, the noise is also very distracting. Every other figure within 1" of this figure suffers -1 Fight.

rows.name: 855. No Body Fat
rows.text: This figure has no body fat at all, giving it a very skeletal appearance. It gains +1 Move but suffers -2 Health.

rows.name: 856. Item Teleportation
rows.text: If this figure is carrying a treasure token, it may forgo all its actions in an activation where it was entitled to at least one action, to teleport the token up to 6", provided the target point is in line of sight. If the target point is another figure that can carry treasure, then this figure is automatically carrying the token; it does not have to pick it up.

rows.name: 857. Weak Inherent Magic
rows.text: This figure may attempt to cast any spell found in the Frostgrave rulebook, except Out of Games spells, but it only succeeds on a Casting Roll of 19 or 20, and the roll may not be empowered by any means. This figure does count as a spellcaster.

rows.name: 858. Arrow Magnet
rows.text: If this figure is standing within 2" of a figure that is the target of a bow, crossbow, or javelin attack, that attack is redirected onto this figure.

rows.name: 859. Damaging Rage
rows.text: This figure can use an action to cast the Strength spell on itself. No Casting Roll is required. However, every time the figure does this, it suffers a permanent -1 Will. If it reaches -5 Will, the figure dies.

rows.name: 860. Keeper of Secrets
rows.text: Roll a die before each game in which this figure participates. If the result is 15+, this warband counts as though it had successfully cast Reveal Secret.

rows.name: 861. Methodical
rows.text: This figure has only one action per activation as its base, thus being wounded or poisoned has no effect on it. It receives +1 to all die rolls that it makes.

rows.name: 862. Spider Master
rows.text: This figure always begins the game with an ice spider next to it. This spider counts as a member of the same warband but does not count against the normal warband size limits. If the spider master leaves the table for any reason, this ice spider immediately becomes an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 863. Blinding Form
rows.text: Any opposing figure that wants to make a shooting attack of any type against this figure must first pass a Will Roll (TN12). If it fails, it is blinded for the remainder of the turn, and its stats are reduced to Move 1, Fight +0, Shoot +0.

rows.name: 864. Immune to Chronomancy
rows.text: This figure is Immune to all spells from the Chronomancer school.

rows.name: 865. Empower Solids
rows.text: This figure can gather mystical energy and transfer it to small objects. These objects can then be thrown and explode on contact. If this figure spends two actions in the same activation, it may hurl one of these objects as though it had cast a Grenade spell.

rows.name: 866. Sacrificial Blood-Enchantment
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it may sacrifice 3 Health as a free action. If done, it receives +2 Fight and +2 damage on melee attacks, and all of its attacks of any kind count as magic attacks until its next activation.

rows.name: 867. Immune to Elementalism
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Elementalist school.

rows.name: 868. Construct Tinkerer
rows.text: This figure always begins the game with a small construct next to it. This construct counts as a member of the same warband but does not count against the normal warband size limits. If the construct tinkerer leaves the table for any reason, this small construct immediately becomes an uncontrolled creature.

rows.name: 869. Greater Demon-Spawn
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, place a greater demon on the spot where the figure fell.

rows.name: 870. Immune to Illusion
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Illusionist school. If it is ever in contact with an illusionary soldier, the illusionary soldier is immediately removed from the table.

rows.name: 871. Does Not Breathe
rows.text: This figure does not need to breathe. It never suffers any ill effects from breathing in harmful substances nor does it ever suffer any damage from failed Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 872. Resistance to Non-Magical Weapons
rows.text: This figure suffers -1 damage from all non-magical attacks or sources of damage.

rows.name: 873. Skeletal Form
rows.text: This figure has only a skeletal form. It gains the Undead and Immune to Control Undead traits.

rows.name: 874. Mostly Immune to Magic
rows.text: Whenever a spell is cast on this figure, or the effect of a spell would target this figure, roll a die. On a 5+ that spell has no effect on this figure. This includes spells that generate magic shooting attacks (but not ones that generate only normal attacks).

rows.name: 875. Skeleton Master
rows.text: If this figure kills another figure in melee combat, immediately place a skeleton where that figure fell. This skeleton counts as part of the same warband as the skeleton master. The skeleton master may only have one such skeleton on the table at a time, so any further kills do not raise a new skeleton. If the skeleton master leaves the table for any reason, or the game ends, the skeleton crumbles to dust.

rows.name: 876. Psychic Death Scream
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, all figures on the table must make a Will Roll (TN10) suffering damage equal to the amount by which they fail.

rows.name: 877. Immune to Necromancy
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Necromancer school.

rows.name: 878. Powerful but Uncoordinated
rows.text: This figure suffers -2 Fight but does double damage in melee combat.

rows.name: 879. Immune to Soothsayer Spells
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Soothsayer school.

rows.name: 880. Explosive Rune Tattoos
rows.text: This figure has a permanent explosive rune tattooed on its skin. Up to three times per game, it can spend an action to trigger the rune. Follow the rules for an explosive rune, centred on this figure. This figure also suffers the +5 attack.

rows.name: 881. Immune to Summoning Magic
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Summoner school.

rows.name: 882. Supreme Bloodboil
rows.text: This figure may supercharge its blood flow. Before each game, it may choose to suffer 6 damage to gain either +2 Fight or +2 Shoot.

rows.name: 883. Master of Secrets
rows.text: Roll a die before each game in which this figure participates. If the result is 11+, this warband counts as though it had successfully cast Reveal Secret.

rows.name: 884. Bullrush
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may move and attack as a single action at +2 Fight. If this figure wins the combat, and has another action available, it may do so again, but only if it moves into combat with a different figure than it did with the first action.

rows.name: 885. Immune to Thaumaturgy
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Thaumaturge school.

rows.name: 886. Six Arms
rows.text: This figure has six arms, though four of them are small and weak. This figure gains an extra item slot.

rows.name: 887. Greater Regeneration
rows.text: This figure gains back up to 3 lost points of Health every time it activates.

rows.name: 888. Uncontrollable Lightning
rows.text: If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" for their Initiative Roll, this figure immediately fires an elemental bolt (as per the spell) at the closest figure, friend or foe, even if the figure is in combat (in which case it will target a random other figure in the combat, not itself). This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 889. Continue after Death
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health (or less), it is not removed from the table. Instead, it stays on the table with 0 Health. Whenever this figure activates, roll a die. On a 1 - 10, it is immediately removed from the table. On any other roll it stays. Also make this roll any time the figure suffers any further damage (though no damage is actually sustained).

rows.name: 890. Uncontrollable Poison Cloud
rows.text: If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" for their Initiative Roll, this figure immediately produces a toxic cloud centred on itself. The cloud is 3" in diameter and blocks all line of sight. Any figure that activates in, or moves through the cloud, must make a Health Roll (TN20) or be immediately poisoned. This figure is immune to the poison of its own cloud. Roll a die at the end of the turn. On a 1 - 5 the cloud dissipates and is removed from the table.

rows.name: 891. Magically Charged
rows.text: This figure has the Magic Attacks trait; however, it may not carry any Magic Weapons, Armour, or Items, as the item's magic and the figure's inherent magic would cancel one another out.

rows.name: 892. Empty Armour
rows.text: This figure gains Heavy Armour, even if it is not usually allowed to wear it. This armour actually is the figure, there is nothing inside. The figure gains the Immune to Poison, Immune to Critical Hits, and Never Wounded traits.

rows.name: 893. Immune to Witchcraft
rows.text: This figure is immune to all spells from the Witch school.

rows.name: 894. Giant Blob
rows.text: This figure is basically a giant blob. Its Fight and Shoot stats both become 0. Its Move stat becomes 3. Its Health Stat goes up by +20. It cannot carry any items or equipment, but never counts as unarmed. It gains the Large trait.

rows.name: 895. Body of Diamond
rows.text: This figure's body is composed of diamond hard crystal. This figure gains +4 Armour and +3 Health, but it may not wear armour of any type.

rows.name: 896. Treasure Eater
rows.text: If this figure is ever within 1" of an unclaimed treasure token (or somehow ends up carrying one), is not in combat, and no other figure is within 1" of the token, the figure eats the token. The token is lost.

rows.name: 897. Massive Blubber
rows.text: This figure has a massive blubbery layer all around its body. It gains +4 Health and is immune to all scenario effects involving cold (though not attacks).

rows.name: 898. Eight Arms
rows.text: This figure has eight arms, though six of them are small and weak. It gains two extra item slots.

rows.name: 899. Uncontrolled Levitation
rows.text: Every time this figure activates, roll a die. On an 11+ it gains the Levitate trait until its next activation.

rows.name: 900. Self-Reanimation
rows.text: The first time this figure rolls a "Dead" result on the survival table, it may treat the roll as "Full Recovery" instead, and the figure gains the Undead trait. The next time the figure rolls a "Dead" result, it is actually dead.

rows.name: 901. Uncontrollable Push
rows.text: If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" for their Initiative Roll, this figure immediately makes a "Push" attack (as per the spell) at the closest figure, friend or foe, even if the figure is in combat. This does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 902. Painful Invisibility
rows.text: Whenever this figure activates, it may turn invisible. It immediately suffers 4 points of damage. No figure can draw line of sight to this figure, or move into combat with it, unless it can see invisible. However, if a figure is in combat, it may fight as normal. This lasts until the figure's next activation.

rows.name: 903. Empowered Action
rows.text: When this figure activates, it may spend 5 of its Health and gain an additional action (to a maximum of 3) for this activation.

rows.name: 904. Crippling Strike
rows.text: Whenever this figure does damage to another figure in melee combat, roll on the Permanent Injury table. The damaged figure suffers the effects of that injury for the remainder of the game. (This injury is not actually permanent and heals after the game.)

rows.name: 905. Time Lord
rows.text: If this figure has at least two actions available, it may use the first to successfully cast Time Store, thus storing the second action for later in the game. It may never have more than one stored action at a time.

rows.name: 906. Miracle Worker
rows.text: After each game, assuming this figure survives, this figure may roll a die. On a 15+ it may heal one permanent injury on a figure in its warband, including itself. On a 19+ it may bring a figure back from the dead that was killed in the proceeding game. This figure returns to full Health with no ill effects.

rows.name: 907. Empowered
rows.text: Every turn this figure gains 3 points of power. These can either be used to empower Casting Rolls or Will Rolls if the figure is a spellcaster or added to any damage the figure does in melee combat during the turn. These points can be divided between different uses during the turn any way the player wishes.

rows.name: 908. Mind Wipe
rows.text: If a warband member enters combat with this figure (initiated by either figure), it must make an immediate Will Roll (TN18). If the roll is failed, the figure suffers -2 Will for the rest of the game. If the figure is a spellcaster, it forgets one random spell that it knows and may not use it for the rest of the game. A figure may only suffer these effects once per game.

rows.name: 909. Burning with Magic
rows.text: This figure suffers 1 point of damage every time it activates. It also gains the Immune to Normal Weapons trait.

rows.name: 910. Extremely Vulnerable Spot
rows.text: If this figure suffers a critical hit, it is immediately reduced to 0 Health and suffers -3 to its Survival Roll after the game.

rows.name: 911. Rusting Touch
rows.text: This figure causes metal to rust, merely by touching it. The figure may not wear heavy armour and all its weapons do -1 damage due to the lack of metal in their construction (except magic weapons which are immune to the effect). Anytime this figure is damaged in melee combat by a figure with a weapon, roll a die. On a 1 - 10 nothing happens; on an 11+ treat that weapon as though it has been hit with a Decay spell.

rows.name: 912. Toughness Against Normal Weapons
rows.text: This figure suffers -1 damage from all non-magical attacks.

rows.name: 913. Fixed Magical Metabolism
rows.text: Roll on the Lesser Potion Table, rerolling any results of 19 or 20. After each game in which this figure is not reduced to 0 Health, the warband gains a potion of this type as it is extruded from the figure's body.

rows.name: 914. Futuristic Projectile Weapon
rows.text: This figure has some sort of futuristic weapon. Treat it as a crossbow that reduces the target's armour by 2 (to a minimum of 10). This weapon may not be given to any other figure or sold. If it is somehow lost or destroyed, it is replaced at the end of the game.

rows.name: 915. Feaster on the Dead
rows.text: This figure likes to consume a portion of all its kills. Any figure reduced to 0 Health by this figure in melee combat suffers -1 to its Survival Roll after the game.

rows.name: 916. Soul Leech
rows.text: Whenever a figure is reduced to 0 Health in line of sight of this figure, this figure regains 1 lost point of Health.

rows.name: 917. Consciousness Grasp
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, it attempts to invade the mind of the closest enemy figure within 6". This enemy figure must make a Will Roll (TN14). If it fails, treat the figure as though it is under a Mind Control spell with a Casting Number of 18, cast by this figure.

rows.name: 918. Echoing Soul
rows.text: Whenever any player rolls to check for a Random Encounter while this figure is on the table, roll three dice instead of one and keep all three results.

rows.name: 919. Mind Parasite
rows.text: If this figure causes damage to another figure in melee combat, treat the damaged figure as though Mind Control had just been cast on it with a Casting Roll of 10 by the damage-dealing figure. Ignore this rule if the figure is not subject to Mind Control.

rows.name: 920. Life Bane
rows.text: Any other figure that activates within 3" of this figure immediately suffers 3 points of damage. Undead and constructs are immune to this ability. This ability does not apply on the first turn of the game.

rows.name: 921. Antithetical to Magic
rows.text: This figure is completely immune to magic in all forms. It may not be the target of any spell, nor will it suffer damage from any kind of magic attack. A figure in combat with this figure may not use any magic item, and any magic items being carried will temporarily lose all bonuses or effects. A figure may fight with a magic weapon but treat it as a mundane example of this weapon. A figure with this trait cannot be a spellcaster or have the Immune to Normal Weapons trait. If it already has either of those, reroll.

rows.name: 922. Great Beauty
rows.text: This figure is stunningly beautiful. Follow the rules as though this figure had Beauty cast upon it with a Casting Number of 14. This is a permanent effect, and not a spell, thus it cannot be cancelled.

rows.name: 923. Ablative Elemental Resistance
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (10), but this decreases by 1 for every point of damage the Resistance prevents. This resets at the start of each game.

rows.name: 924. Partial Invisibility
rows.text: No figures can draw line of sight to this figure, or move into combat with it, unless they begin an action within 3". Figures with True Sight ignore this ability.

rows.name: 925. Potential Elemental Reflection
rows.text: If this figure is ever the target of an elemental shooting attack, roll a die. On a 1 - 10, nothing happens, proceed with the attack as normal. On an 11+ it may nominate any other figure in line of sight as the new target for the attack, including the figure that caused the attack. This decision is made before any dice are rolled.

rows.name: 926. Incredibly Dense
rows.text: This figure gains +2 Armour but suffers -8 to all Swimming Rolls.

rows.name: 927. Hardened Ablative Skin
rows.text: This figure has a tough skin that it sheds and regrows. The figure gains +5 Health; however, the first 5 points of damage the figure takes during a game cannot be healed by any means in game - they only return for the next game.

rows.name: 928. Self-Possession
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to invite a demon into its own body. Treat the figure as though it is under the effect of a Possess spell.

rows.name: 929. Ethereal Flicker
rows.text: This figure flickers between being material and ethereal. Whenever the figure activates, roll a die. On an 11+ the figure gains the Ethereal trait until its next activation. While ethereal this figure may not pick up any treasure tokens and drops any that it is carrying, but it is also Immune to Non-magical weapons.

rows.name: 930. Crayfish Head
rows.text: This figure has the head of a crayfish and gains the Amphibious trait.

rows.name: 931. Curse of Immortality
rows.text: This figure must always reroll any "Dead" results when rolling for survival. However, anytime it does so, it suffers a permanent -1 to every stat (so -1 Move, -1 Fight, etc.). Additionally, it loses six levels if it has levels.

rows.name: 932. Undead Hands
rows.text: This figure cannot carry any weapons or a shield, but it never counts as unarmed. This figure gains the Energy Drain and Magic Attacks traits.

rows.name: 933. Massively Unstable Portal
rows.text: This figure is a portal to other realms. If the controlling player ever rolls a natural "1" for their Initiative Roll while this figure is on the table, place an uncontrolled minor demon on the table 3d6" away from this figure in a random direction.

rows.name: 934. Burst of Quickness
rows.text: Every time this figure activates, roll a die. On a 16+ it gains one additional action this activation (unless another rule prevents it from having more than one action) to a maximum of three actions.

rows.name: 935. Power Slam
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may attempt a power slam attack. The figure must be the one initiating the combat, and it must decide to use this ability before any dice are rolled. If this attack hits, it does +10 damage.

rows.name: 936. Magic Infusion
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to touch an allied figure within 1", including itself. All attacks from the touched figure count as magic attacks for the remainder of the game.

rows.name: 937. Painfully Insubstantial
rows.text: This figure is never locked in combat. It may freely move out of combat. In addition, no figure may force combat against this figure unless this figure allows it. However, the figure suffers 1 point of damage at the end of all its activations.

rows.name: 938. Animal Charmer
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to attempt to charm all animals within 12" and line of sight. Any qualifying animal must make a Will Roll (TN14) or receive no actions the next time it activates.

rows.name: 939. The Will to Live
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure is reduced to 0 Health by an attack, it may instead remain on the table at 1 Health. However, if it is later reduced to 0 Health, it suffers -2 to its Survival Roll after the game.

rows.name: 940. Immune to Elemental Magic Damage
rows.text: Any elemental magic damage done against this figure is reduced to 0. If this figure is already Immune to Non-Magic Weapons, reroll this ability.

rows.name: 941. Animated Skin
rows.text: Once per game, this figure can spend an action to "shed its skin". This creates a second version of this figure that has the same stats but only 6 Health. This second version counts as a soldier in the same warband as the original but may not cast spells or use any Tricks of the Trade. This figure has all the same equipment as the original, except none of it is magical (so replace magic weapons with mundane versions, while magic items, potions, etc. are essentially worthless).

rows.name: 942. Flaming Bile Stream
rows.text: This figure can vomit flaming bile. This figure may make shooting attacks with an 8" range, that do +2 damage and count as magic attacks.

rows.name: 943. Mental Strike
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to make a mental attack against any enemy within 6" and line of sight. Fight a round of combat as normal, except both figures use their Will stat instead of their Fight stat and neither figure can receive supporting figure bonuses. Both figures are counted as having Armour 10 for this combat. Damage is done as normal, but regardless of who wins, neither figure may step back or push back. These figures are not considered to be in combat.

rows.name: 944. Flaming Bullrush
rows.text: Once per game, this figure may burst into flames, then move and attack as a single action. This attack is at +2 Fight, +2 Damage, and counts as an elemental magic attack. If this figure wins the combat, and has another action available, it may do so again, but only if it moves into combat with a different figure than it did with the first action.

rows.name: 945. Boom Stick
rows.text: This figure has some sort of futuristic weapon. Treat it as a crossbow that does not need a turn to reload. This weapon may not be given to any other figure or sold. If it is somehow lost or destroyed, it is replaced at the end of the game.

rows.name: 946. Rusting Presence
rows.text: This figure causes metal to rust, merely by being near it. The figure may not wear heavy armour and all its weapons do -1 damage due to the lack of metal in their construction (except magic weapons which are immune to the effect). Anytime this figure completes a round of melee combat, all other figures suffer a Decay spell targeted on a random weapon.

rows.name: 947. Wild Spellcaster
rows.text: Before each game, roll three random spells. This figure may attempt to cast those spells during the game at its base Casting Number. This figure counts as a spellcaster and may empower rolls.

rows.name: 948. Heart-Feaster
rows.text: Any figure reduced to 0 Health by this figure in melee combat suffers -1 to its Survival Roll after the game, for reasons that should be obvious.

rows.name: 949. Consciousness Leap
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, it attempts to invade the mind of the closest enemy figure within 6". This enemy figure must make a Will Roll (TN18). If it fails, treat the figure as though it is under a Mind Control spell with a Casting Number of 18, cast by this figure.

rows.name: 950. Armoured Ball
rows.text: This figure has heavy armour plates along its back and can roll up into an armoured ball. This figure gains +2 Armour but suffers -1 Move and may not wear any type of Armour or use a shield. Whenever this figure is activated, it may "roll up" into a ball. If so, its Armour is increased by a further +4, but its Move is reduced by a further 4 to a minimum of 2. While rolled up, the figure may not make any kind of shooting attacks, pick or drop treasure tokens, or climb upwards. The figure stays rolled up until its next activation.

rows.name: 951. Crocodile Jaws for Hands
rows.text: This figure doesn't have hands, instead it has a pair of crocodile jaws. This figure may not use any weapons or a shield. However, it never counts as unarmed, it gains +1 Fight, and all of its melee attacks do +2 damage.

rows.name: 952. Magical Metabolism
rows.text: If this figure reaches the end of a game without being reduced to 0 Health, it may roll for one random potion that it extrudes from its body.

rows.name: 953. Never Average
rows.text: Any time this figure rolls a natural "10 or 11" on any roll, it must reroll and take the second result.

rows.name: 954. Highly Empowered
rows.text: Every turn this figure gains 5 points of power. These can either be used to empower Casting Rolls or Will Rolls if the figure is a spellcaster or added to any damage the figure does in melee combat during the turn. These points can be divided between different uses during the turn any way the player wishes.

rows.name: 955. Extremely Hard to Kill
rows.text: Whenever this figure rolls on the Survival Table it must roll three dice and select the highest result.

rows.name: 956. Extreme Regeneration
rows.text: This figure gains back up to 3 lost points of Health every time it activates. Additionally, this figure never suffers either Permanent Injury or Badly Wounded results on the Survival Table; count these as Full Recovery instead.

rows.name: 957. Shared Pain
rows.text: Whenever this figure suffers damage, it must select another figure within line of sight. That figure must make an immediate Will Roll (TN14) or take half as much damage rounded down. So, if the figure takes 7 damage, the other figure takes 3 if it fails its Will Roll. If there are no other figures within line of sight, this figure takes an additional 1 point of damage.

rows.name: 958. Terrain Destroyer
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to cast the Crumble spell. This spell is always successful and no Casting Roll is required.

rows.name: 959. Illusionary Self
rows.text: This figure can project an illusionary version of itself. At the start of the game, treat this figure as though it successfully cast an Illusionary Soldier spell. The illusionary soldier has the same stats as this figure, except Health.

rows.name: 960. Deal with the Devil
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure is called upon to make a die roll, it may instead roll five dice and pick which one to use. However, if any two or more dice roll the same number, the figure is immediately reduced to 0 Health after the other results of the die roll have been handled.

rows.name: 961. Ablative Scales
rows.text: This figure cannot wear armour of any type. Its natural armour stat is increased to 16. However, whenever it takes damage, of any amount, its Armour Stat drops by 1 (down to a minimum of 10).

rows.name: 962. Deathmark
rows.text: This figure has a symbol of death scarred into its forehead. Any attack this figure does in melee combat does +5 damage if, and only if, that +5 damage would reduce its opponent to 0 Health or less.

rows.name: 963. Blinding Quickness
rows.text: Every time this figure activates, roll a die. On an 11+ it gains one additional action this activation (unless another rule prevents it from having more than one action).

rows.name: 964. Four Arms
rows.text: This figure is allowed to carry two shields and a two-handed weapon or staff at the same time. Alternatively, it may carry a two-handed weapon or staff, plus two hand weapons, in which case it gains +1 Fight.

rows.name: 965. Elemental Reflection
rows.text: If this figure is ever the target of an elemental shooting attack, it may nominate any other figure in line of sight as the new target for the attack. This decision is made before any dice are rolled.

rows.name: 966. Stonegaze
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to automatically cast the Petrify spell with a Casting Roll of 14 on a figure within 6".

rows.name: 967. Incredibly Quick
rows.text: This figure always activates before all other figures in a turn, regardless of phases or any other rules. If there are two figures with this ability, or other abilities that have the same rule, such figures should roll off to see who goes first. This figure may never group activate.

rows.name: 968. Mystic Shield
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to summon a mystical shield. This follows the same rules as the Elemental Shield spell.

rows.name: 969. Partial Immunity to Normal Weapons
rows.text: This figure suffers only half damage, rounded down, from non-magical attacks.

rows.name: 970. Elemental Charge
rows.text: This figure can spend an action to charge its own weapon as though Elemental Hammer had been cast upon it.

rows.name: 971. Mind Infestation
rows.text: If this figure causes damage to another figure in melee combat, treat the damaged figure as though Mind Control had just been cast on it with a Casting Roll of 14 by the damage-dealing figure. Ignore this rule if the figure is not subject to Mind Control.

rows.name: 972. Nearly Immortal
rows.text: This figure can always reroll any "Dead" results when rolling for survival. However, anytime it does so, it suffers a permanent -3 Will and -2 Health (and loses five levels if it has levels).

rows.name: 973. Far Teleportation
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to teleport d20" in a random direction. This ability can be used while in combat.

rows.name: 974. Stormborn
rows.text: Every time this figure suffers at least 1 point of damage, it automatically casts Call Storm with no roll or action necessary.

rows.name: 975. Second Chance
rows.text: This figure literally has two lives. Essentially the first time it rolls a "Dead" result on the Survival Table, treat the result as "Full Recovery" instead.

rows.name: 976. Immense Resilience
rows.text: The figure gains +10 Health.

rows.name: 977. Stunning Beauty
rows.text: This figure is stunningly beautiful. Follow the rules as though this figure had the Beauty spell cast upon it with a Casting Number of 18. This is a permanent effect, and not a spell, thus it cannot be cancelled.

rows.name: 978. Body of Flame
rows.text: This figure cannot wear armour. All its melee attacks count as elemental magic attacks and do +2 damage. Any figure that forces combat with this figure immediately suffers 2 points of elemental magic damage.

rows.name: 979. Tornado Spin
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to spin around at terrific speed. All figures within 6" must make a Move Roll (TN16). If a figure fails, it is moved a number of inches equal to the amount by which it failed directly away from this figure and takes damage of the same amount. A figure may make this spin even while in combat.

rows.name: 980. Psychic Death Shriek
rows.text: If this figure is reduced to 0 Health, all figures on the table must make a Will Roll (TN14) suffering damage equal to the amount by which they fail.

rows.name: 981. Adamantine Elemental Armour
rows.text: This figure gains Elemental Resistance (6).

rows.name: 982. Invisible
rows.text: No figures can draw line of sight to this figure, or move into combat with it, unless they can see invisible. However, if a figure is in combat, it may fight as normal. This figure does not count as invisible while carrying a treasure token.

rows.name: 983. Raging Attack
rows.text: This figure may spend one action to make an attack against every figure it is currently in combat with. It makes separate Combat Rolls against each one, and all supporting bonuses apply. This figure may choose the order the attacks are made.

rows.name: 984. Inherent Magic
rows.text: This figure may attempt to cast any spell found in the Frostgrave rulebook, but it only succeeds on a Casting Roll of 20. The roll may be empowered in the normal way. This figure counts as a spellcaster.

rows.name: 985. Mind-Stealer
rows.text: If this figure damages another figure in melee combat, the damaged figure must make a Will Roll (TN16). If it fails, it becomes a temporary member of this figure's warband. It may make another Will Roll to break this control at the end of each of its activations. Figures with Mind Lock or Immune to Mind Control are immune to this ability.

rows.name: 986. Restructure Body
rows.text: Every time this figure activates, it may choose one of the following traits: Amphibious, Expert Climber, Immune to Poison, or Never Wounded. This figure has this trait until its next activation.

rows.name: 987. Immune to Normal Weapons
rows.text: This figure can only be hurt by magical weapons or magical spell effects.

rows.name: 988. Partially Insubstantial
rows.text: This figure is never locked in combat. It may freely move out of combat. In addition, no figure may force combat against this figure unless this figure allows it.

rows.name: 989. Miracle Wielder
rows.text: After each game, and after this figure makes a Survival Roll if necessary, this figure may roll a die. On an 11+ it may heal one permanent injury on a figure in its warband, including itself. On a 15+ it may bring a figure back from the dead that was killed in the proceeding game. This figure returns to full Health with no ill effects.

rows.name: 990. Immortal
rows.text: This figure can always reroll any "Dead" results when rolling for survival. However, anytime it does so, it suffers a permanent -2 Will (and loses two levels if it has levels).

rows.name: 991. Greased Lightning
rows.text: This figure has three actions per activation as standard.

rows.name: 992. Mirror Image
rows.text: This figure always projects an exact duplicate image of itself adjacent to it. When making a shooting attack against this figure, first roll a die. On a 1 - 10 the shot targets the image and automatically misses.

rows.name: 993. Elemental Blast
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to make a +8 elemental magic shooting attack with a maximum range of 3".

rows.name: 994. Force Bubble
rows.text: This figure may spend an action to form a bubble of force around itself that pushes all other figures away. All figures in line of sight suffer a +10 shooting attack, but instead of damage, they are moved a number of inches equal to the amount of damage they would have taken directly away from this figure. A figure will stop if it hits any terrain over 1" high but will move over shorter terrain or other figures.

rows.name: 995. Massive
rows.text: This figure does +5 damage in melee combat and gains the Large trait.

rows.name: 996. Reform
rows.text: Once per game, if this figure is not in combat, it may spend an action to return to its original starting Health.

rows.name: 997. Celerity
rows.text: This creature is incredibly fast and activates twice in every turn.
